jobs.title: Restaurant Leader (General Manager)
jobs.description:
Your Role at Raising Cane’s:

The Restaurant Leader is responsible for strategic direction for their restaurant and must maintain operations standards and drive results through people development, sales and profit growth. This role is tasked with teaching, modeling and upholding Raising Cane’s culture standards for all crewmembers, customers and partners.

The physical work environment includes working in a fast-paced kitchen environment (which requires extended periods of physical exertion, such as walking, standing, lifting and bending) and interacting with customers. It also includes both inside and outside work in varied temperatures, working with and around food products, common allergens, industrial equipment, commercial cleaning products that require the use of personal protective equipment and physical activities necessary to complete the responsibilities of the job.

Your Impact and Responsibilities:

Purpose of the position:

• Ensures overall financial success of the restaurant and is responsible for forecasting and budgeting
• Ensures overall restaurant compliance to company standards, policies and laws
• Hires and terminates management-level crewmembers including status change and payroll process
• Creates crewmember work and training schedules
• Develops management-level crewmembers including performance management
• Acts as manager on duty, opens and closes the restaurant, manages cash handling
• Monitors profit and loss statements, develops and executes strategy in all areas of financial and operational performance

General to the role:

• Enforces Raising Cane’s policies and standards
• Uses required tools, forms and logs to support shift execution, document results and take corrective action when needed
• Deploys crewmembers during a shift and provides exemplary customer service
• Utilizes reward and recognition program for the crewmembers in the restaurant
• Authorizes employee functions requiring manager approval (e.g. discounts, timeclock overrides, etc.)
• Ensures cleanliness of the restaurant and ensures the facility is in good working order
• Achieves and maintains training restaurant status
• Achieves “meets expectations” or better metrics in all crewmember and operations performance metrics
• Completes other duties as assigned

Requirements for Success:

• Detail-oriented, organized and able to manage multiple priorities that may be constantly changing
• Self-driven, flexible, and highly energetic with strong analytical, written and verbal communication skills
• Able to work effectively and efficiently both independently and collaboratively
• Able to recognize problems, set goals, create plans and convert plans into action to solve problems
• Able to measure performance, subjectively and objectively with a high level of emotional intelligence
• Proficient in a variety of technology systems including Microsoft Office (Excel, Word and Outlook) and ability to learn and adapt to new systems quickly
• Able to work a variety of shifts including days, evenings and weekends and travel as needed for work-related functions and training
• Able to manage all public dealings in a professional manner, consistent with Raising Cane’s policies and acts as a brand ambassador inside and outside the restaurant
• 5+ years of restaurant or retail management experience
• New restaurant opening and local restaurant marketing experience preferred
• Must be 18 years of age or older
• High school diploma or equivalent required, some college preferred
• Possess a valid driver’s license

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Seasonal Retail Ambassador - Short Hills
jobs.description:
SEASONAL RETAIL AMBASSADOR

Short Hills, NJ - The Mall at Short Hills

At Rothy’s, we believe there’s a better way to do business—one that puts the planet and its people first. That’s why we’ve transformed millions of plastic bottles into stylish, sustainable shoes and bags, creating wardrobe staples that look just as good as they feel.

In our retail stores, clienteling, and genuine connection are at the heart of everything we do. We take pride in building lasting relationships with our customers—getting to know their style, anticipating their needs, and creating personalized experiences that make them feel truly seen and supported. Whether it’s helping someone find their perfect fit or sharing the story behind our sustainable designs, every interaction is an opportunity to deepen that connection.

As we grow, we’re cultivating not just a workplace, but a community. It’s a place where careers can grow, ideas are shared, and people feel a true sense of belonging. Every day brings new opportunities to learn, lead, and make an impact—together, as part of a welcoming, inclusive team that celebrates each other’s contributions.




ABOUT THE TEAM:

Shopping at Rothy’s IRL is not your ordinary retail experience—so naturally, our Stores team is extraordinary, too. Experts in the fit, wear and sizing of our shoes, these team members provide deep knowledge of every Rothy’s style and out-of-this-world customer service—creating long-lasting brand loyalty. Customers love shopping in our stores due to these exceptional interactions.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Retail Ambassador, you will be the representative of the brand on the sales floor, delivering exceptional customer experiences and living our company values in every interaction. You’ll focus on creating meaningful connections with customers, driving sales through service, and supporting a welcoming, inclusive store culture. While your primary focus is on sales, you will also assist with limited operational tasks to ensure the store is well-maintained and running smoothly.




WHAT YOU’LL DO:

Customer Experience (90%)

 - Deliver the Rothy’s Experience to every customer—a best in class service experience rooted in Rothy’s values—consistently embodying the brand through presentation, communication, and product expertise

 - Drive personal sales and results and contribute to team goals

 - Create lasting relationships with our customers by engaging in strong clienteling practices

 - Contribute to a positive, inclusive, and service driven store culture by modeling collaborative, team focused behavior

Operational Excellence (10%)

 - Execute assigned responsibilities accurately as part of daily store operations, including stock replenishment, visual merchandising support, and store organization and cleanliness

 - Demonstrate knowledge of store operations and policies, following established procedures and SOPs to ensure operational excellence and compliance




YOU ARE:

 - Guided by Rothy’s values and committed to fostering a welcoming, service driven environment:
   
   - Embrace Possibility.  We dream BIG, really big
   
   - Obsess Over Innovation: We never accept the status quo
   
   - Make the Planet Proud.  We make the right choice, not the easy one
   
   - Collaboration is Key.  We’re laser focused on driving results

 - 18 years of age or older




YOU HAVE:

 - Previous retail or customer service experience preferred

 - Strong communication skills and the ability to build genuine customer connections

 - A passion for service and the drive to achieve personal and team sales goals

 - Willingness to support operational tasks as part of the team

 - Availability to work at least 16 hours/week, either 3 Peak Days (Friday, Saturdays, Sundays + Holidays) OR 2 Peak Days (Friday, Saturdays, Sundays + Holidays) + 2 Non-Peak Days (Mondays - Thursdays)

 - Ability to stand/walk an entire shift

 - Ability to lift, push carry or otherwise move up to 25 lbs

 - Ability to frequently bending, reaching, stretching, and safely use ladders and step stools

 - Ability to uphold Rothy’s Experience by following our dress code, including wearing Rothy’s shoes during every shift




PAY RANGE:

$18.00 - $19.00 per hour

Base pay is one part of the total rewards package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work.  This role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, as well as a comprehensive benefits package.

Base pay will vary based on factors such as qualifications, experience, skill level, competencies and work location. We will meet minimum wage or minimum of the pay range (whichever is higher) based on city, county and state requirements.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Web Application Services
jobs.description:
Why Thunderbird?

Thunderbird is one of the world’s most trusted open-source email applications, empowering more than 20 million people globally. At Thunderbird, we build privacy-respecting communication and productivity tools that help people manage their digital lives while staying in control of their data.

We are open source by design. Our products are developed transparently and in collaboration with a global community of contributors, and that same spirit shapes how we work: collaboratively, inclusively, and with a shared commitment to putting users first.

Our small but growing distributed team includes more than 65 people across seven countries. As Thunderbird evolves beyond a single desktop application, we are expanding across desktop, mobile, paid services, AI offerings, and enterprise-facing work to build independent, privacy-respecting alternatives to big tech ecosystems.

Our revenue model combines user donations, which help keep Thunderbird’s applications freely available, with paid services that cover the costs of hosted offerings while supporting long-term sustainability and continued innovation.

A note about Thunderbird and Mozilla: Thunderbird Technologies Corporation is the nonprofit-owned company behind Thunderbird email and a growing portfolio of products. While part of the Mozilla family, Thunderbird is a separate entity from Mozilla Corporation and Mozilla Foundation with its own compensation programs, benefits, and employment policies.

To learn more, visit www.thunderbird.net

The opportunity

As a Staff Software Engineer, Services, you’ll help shape the architecture and technical direction of web-based products that extend Thunderbird beyond email. The Services team is currently focused on building offerings such as an appointment calendar and secure file storage and transfer solutions, creating valuable experiences for our users while supporting additional revenue streams for Thunderbird.

This is a Staff-level individual contributor role with significant technical ownership and influence. You’ll work with designers, engineers, and community members to write code, build prototypes, solve complex problems, and make technical decisions that shape our products. You’ll take a holistic view of our code and systems, helping establish the architecture and software patterns that allow our Services products to evolve and scale.

You’ll also take on broad, ambiguous problems that have a direct impact on our goals, from improving our technical architecture to helping grow Services users and subscribers. Along the way, you’ll provide technical and product direction across teams, mentor other engineers, and identify ways to make our systems and processes more sustainable, scalable, and easier to work with.

What you’ll do

• Lead the technical architecture of new Services products, taking ownership of complex projects and identifying improvements that strengthen our systems as they evolve.

• Write code, build prototypes and experiments, and contribute throughout the development lifecycle, from planning and testing through implementation, monitoring, and maintenance.

• Help establish software patterns and make technical decisions across our Services products, including investigating and proposing technology choices.

• Build and evolve analytics and infrastructure that help the team use user-generated data to inform decisions.

• Take on ambiguous, high-level problems with broad scope and direct impact on Services goals, including growing users and subscribers.

• Provide technical and product direction across Thunderbird and lead technical collaboration with other parts of Mozilla and community contributors when needed.

• Work closely with the team and community to surface issues, refine ideas, and develop practical solutions.

• Identify and plan improvements that make our systems and processes more accessible, self-serviceable, lower friction, sustainable, scalable, and easier to delegate.

• Mentor other engineers through code review, documentation, technical discussions, process improvements, and ongoing guidance.

• Stay current with evolving technologies, coding standards, libraries, and frameworks and apply that knowledge to your work.

What you bring

• 10+ years of web software development experience, including experience designing scalable and efficient systems and launching complex web projects at scale.

• Expert-level JavaScript skills and knowledge of at least one additional programming language, such as Python, Rust, Go, or C++.

• An understanding of the business landscape, including challenges and opportunities, and experience collaborating with teams to expand Thunderbird’s user and donor base.

• Experience with front-end frameworks, full-stack development, and/or API development.

• Strong knowledge of software development practices, including testing, code review, and documentation, and the ability to help others develop these skills.

• Experience acting as a technical lead, solving complex technical problems, and providing mentorship and guidance to other engineers.

• Experience collaborating remotely across disciplines such as engineering, product management, QA, and design.

• Excellent written and verbal English communication and documentation skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and concisely with an international, geographically distributed team.

• Comfort working in an open-source environment and a commitment to Mozilla values.

• Ability to learn, evaluate, and responsibly use emerging technologies, including AI-enabled tools, to improve work processes.

• A commitment to continuous learning and staying current with industry trends and technologies.

• Ability and willingness to travel periodically, including internationally.

Bonus points for

• Experience with product management or product-focused work.

What success looks like

Success in this role will look like a strong technical leader who not only helps the Web Services team grow, but also has a direct hand in helping Thunderbird grow and evolve our product offerings.

Over time, your work will help:

• Grow & mature scalable, modern software patterns and architecture across Web Services products.

• Turn new product ideas and complex technical problems into working solutions, prototypes, and experiments.

• Partner with leadership and cross-functional partners (Product, Design, etc) to help generate data-driven product decisions.

• Provide clear technical and product direction across complex, cross-functional work.

• Help other engineers grow their technical, collaboration, and leadership skills.

• Support the growth of users and subscribers as Thunderbird expands its offerings beyond email.

Work environment

This is a full-time, fully remote position. You’ll join a distributed team of Thunderbird staff, open-source community members, and contributors from around the world.

We rely on clear communication, thoughtful documentation, and collaborative decision-making to work effectively across time zones and disciplines.

In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with designers, engineers, cross-functional teams across Thunderbird, other parts of Mozilla, and community contributors.

Compensation & benefits

We benchmark our base salaries to local markets and target the 60th percentile of the peer market. The salary ranges for this role are:

• US: $180,000 - $215,000 USD

We may consider candidates with strong skills but less than the required experience. Title, level and compensation will be determined based on qualifications and experience.

In addition to competitive salaries, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your whole self.

Work & career

• Fully remote work & schedule flexibility

• Company-provided laptop

• Annual bonus program

• Monthly remote work stipend

• Annual professional development stipend

• Access to Coursera learning platform

• Industry conferences

• Company all-hands and team gatherings

Rest & play

• 24 days PTO per year (prorated)

• Your birthday

• Year-end company shutdown

• 9 wellbeing days

• Public holidays

• Other paid leave

• Quarterly wellbeing stipend for personal / family activities

Health & family

• 401(k) contributions

• Health, dental, & vision insurance

• Disability insurance

• Life insurance

• Employee assistance program

• Paid parental leave

• Paid sick days

Work eligibility

Applicants must reside in and have permanent work authorization for the country location(s) specified in the posting. We are unable to consider applicants outside of these markets at this time. And, we do not provide visa sponsorship.

How to apply

Please apply directly through our career page. We carefully review every cover letter and screening question, so take the time to answer each fully. We value authentic, thoughtful responses that reflect your own experience and perspective. It is fine to use AI tools to polish your writing, but your answers should be your own. Candidates who submit generic or unoriginal AI-generated responses may be disqualified from further consideration.

Our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion

Thunderbird believes in the value of diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge, and knows diversity, equity and inclusion are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities and expressions.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race (including hairstyle and texture), religion (including religious grooming and dress practices), gender, gender identity, gender expression, color, national origin, pregnancy, ancestry, domestic partner status, disability, sexual orientation, age, genetic predisposition, medical condition, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable laws. Thunderbird will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior, conduct, or purpose.

We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at hiringaccommodations@thunderbird.net to request accommodation.

#LI-DNI

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff (New Grad)
jobs.description:
Welcome! This is the general application portal for university students and recent graduates who wish to be considered for full-time Member of Technical Staff positions at Perplexity. Our elite new grad cohorts enjoy unparalleled mentorship, top-of-market compensation, and the chance to tackle some of the deepest, thorniest challenges in frontier intelligence https://www.perplexity.ai/hub/blog/category/research.



NOTE: if you attend one of our focus schools listed below, please do not apply via this portal as it is infrequently monitored due to high volume. Apply instead via the school-specific application portal to ensure your application receives priority attention.





FOCUS SCHOOLS (UNITED STATES)

Caltech https://pplx.ai/2026Caltech | Columbia https://pplx.ai/2026Columbia | Cornell https://pplx.ai/2026Cornell | CMU https://pplx.ai/2026CMU | Duke https://pplx.ai/2026Duke | Georgia Tech https://pplx.ai/2026GATech
Harvard https://pplx.ai/2026Harvard | MIT https://pplx.ai/2026MIT | Michigan https://pplx.ai/2026Michigan | Northwestern https://pplx.ai/2026Northwestern | NYU https://pplx.ai/2026NYU | Penn https://pplx.ai/2026Penn
Princeton https://pplx.ai/2026Princeton | Purdue https://pplx.ai/2026Purdue | Stanford https://pplx.ai/2026Stanford | UC Berkeley https://pplx.ai/2026Berkeley | UChicago https://pplx.ai/2026UChicago
UCLA https://pplx.ai/2026UCLA | UIUC https://pplx.ai/2026UIUC | UNC Chapel Hill https://pplx.ai/2026UNC | UT Austin https://pplx.ai/2026UTAustin
UWashington https://pplx.ai/2026UW | Yale https://pplx.ai/2026Yale


FOCUS SCHOOLS (CANADA)

McGill https://pplx.ai/2026McGill | UBC https://pplx.ai/2026UBC | UToronto https://pplx.ai/2026UToronto | Waterloo https://pplx.ai/2026Waterloo




EARLY CAREER TALENT @ PERPLEXITY

Perplexity believes that exceptionally talented individuals at any stage can thrive in our high-velocity, high-ownership culture.  Our early career talent program revolves around:

 - Breadth: New grads at Perplexity work across the stack, from Perplexity's agent harnesses to our AI inference and training systems. Many of our most beloved features and most important systems were shipped by individuals fresh out of school.

 - Depth: New grads are entrusted (and expected) to dive deep into whatever problem domains you work on. Often, your work will require you to become a world expert in some problem space that few others in the world have encountered.

 - Mentorship & Growth: We keep the size of our entering new grad cohorts at well below 10% of our technical team. Each individual enjoys a rich network of mentors to help them grow, and our new grads have a track record of becoming some of Perplexity's most senior and prolific team members.

 - Recognition: We select for the best and we recognize them accordingly. We set our early career compensation to rise well above that of top tech companies and startups. Post-hire, we aggressively recognize and reward growth in role.

 - Mission: Perplexity is AI for people who expect more. Our mission is to build frontier intelligence for the world's most discerning users, and each contribution you make will directly advance that mission.




ACADEMIC REQUIREMENTS

If you're not applying from a focus school listed above, we typically require you to possess the following qualifications:

 1. GPA of ≥3.92, averaged across all CS and Math classes; and

 2. Grade of A or A+ in your school's upper-level algorithms course.

Additional advanced coursework in areas such as systems, AI/ML, advanced math, and other rigorous subjects is highly welcome.

 


NON-QUALIFYING APPLICATIONS - EVIDENCE OF EXCEPTIONAL ABILITY

While you're welcome to submit your application if you don't meet these criteria, we will be looking for other evidence of exceptional ability. You are encouraged to briefly describe this evidence in response to the "Anything Else" question at the bottom of the application form.




NOTE ON FELLOWSHIP OPPORTUNITIES

This portal accepts applications for full-time roles at Perplexity. Internship applications are not accepted via this portal. If you're interested in short-term opportunities with our team, you may instead be interested in the Perplexity Research Fellowship. The Fellowship has a separate application process detailed here https://pplx.ai/fellowship. Note that Fellowship applications are extremely competitive; in particular, we don't expect to admit any undergraduate students to the Fellowship before their final year of study.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

VML is a global creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce to create connected brands that drive growth. Guided by a Human First philosophy, VML is known for its innovative work for brands and consistently ranks among the world’s leading creative companies, including the WARC Creative 100. VML’s global network spans 55+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore.

VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.

For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on  LinkedIn #WeAreVML.

.

Freelance - Senior Project Manager - Health

Who we are looking for:

VML is looking for a Freelance Senior Project Manager - Health with a breadth and depth of expertise to champion omnichannel work across multiple workstreams with a focus excellent delivery at the center. This is an exciting opportunity to lead the delivery of innovative solutions bringing together creative, data and technology across the entire customer journey.

To be successful in this role, you must possess advertising agency experience in both digital, social, print and integrated marketing, building delivery and project experiences and creating compelling content for a major Health/Pharma Client Account. CRM experience is very helpful but not required. You must have a strong creative sensibility, a genuine interest in user-centered design, and a hands-on understanding of content production for all channels.

In this role, you will be responsible for leading talented teams to understand client needs, market forces and consumer sentiments to deliver effective solutions. You will be accountable for ensuring all project deliverables are of high-quality, completed on time and on budget, and are aligned with the brand’s goals. You must have the ability to maintain the broad vision required for executing a project, including strategic thinking and leadership from beginning to end, as well as the talent for overseeing all the small details that add up to fulfilling our commitment to client satisfaction and project requirements. jobs.title: F&B Server
jobs.description:
The F&B Server is responsible for delivering warm, personalized, and attentive food and beverage service to guests while creating meaningful and memorable experiences in line with Our Habitas service philosophy and standards.

The role ensures that guests are welcomed naturally, orders are taken accurately, food and beverages are served professionally, and all guest needs are anticipated throughout their dining experience.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Guest Experience & Service

• Welcome and engage guests in a warm, confident, natural, and personalized manner.
• Create genuine connections with guests while maintaining professional and appropriate interactions.
• Present menus and confidently explain food and beverage offerings, ingredients, preparation methods, and daily specials.
• Take accurate food and beverage orders and communicate them promptly to the kitchen and bar teams.
• Anticipate guest needs and provide attentive service without being intrusive.
• Personalize interactions by recognizing guest preferences, names, special occasions, and dietary requirements whenever possible.
• Serve food and beverages according to established service standards and sequence of service.
• Regularly check guest satisfaction and respond promptly to requests or concerns.
• Handle guest feedback professionally and immediately escalate concerns when management assistance is required.
• Thank guests genuinely and ensure a warm farewell at the conclusion of their experience.

Food & Beverage Operations

• Prepare assigned restaurant, bar, pool, beach, event, or other F&B service areas before operations.
• Complete mise-en-place and ensure service stations are fully stocked and organized.
• Maintain cleanliness and presentation of tables, chairs, menus, service equipment, and surrounding areas.
• Ensure correct table setup according to the meal period and outlet requirements.
• Coordinate closely with the kitchen, bar, stewarding, and other departments to ensure smooth and timely service.
• Serve and clear food, beverages, plates, glassware, and cutlery efficiently.
• Process guest bills and payments accurately in accordance with established procedures.
• Ensure correct posting of charges to guest rooms or other applicable accounts.
• Assist with restaurant opening and closing procedures.
• Support special events, private dining, functions, and resort activations when required.

Product Knowledge & Upselling

• Maintain strong knowledge of all menus, beverages, promotions, and resort offerings.
• Understand ingredients and common allergens and communicate dietary requirements accurately to the kitchen.
• Recommend dishes and beverages based on guest preferences.
• Practice suggestive selling and upselling naturally while prioritizing the guest experience.
• Participate in menu briefings, tastings, training sessions, and product knowledge activities.

Hygiene, Safety & Compliance

• Follow all food safety, hygiene, sanitation, and HACCP requirements.
• Maintain excellent personal hygiene and grooming standards at all times.
• Ensure food and beverages are handled safely and appropriately.
• Immediately report hazards, accidents, equipment defects, or safety concerns.
• Follow all resort policies, procedures, security requirements, and emergency procedures.
• Handle resort property, equipment, and supplies responsibly.

Teamwork & Our Habitas Culture

• Work collaboratively with colleagues across Food & Beverage and other departments.
• Support colleagues during busy periods to maintain a seamless guest experience.
• Communicate clearly, respectfully, and professionally with team members.
• Participate actively in daily briefings, training sessions, meetings, and resort activities.
• Demonstrate flexibility and willingness to assist in different F&B areas according to operational requirements.
• Consistently demonstrate the Our Habitas values and contribute to a positive, inclusive, and respectful workplace.
• Take ownership of the guest experience rather than limiting responsibilities to assigned tables or sections.

• Previous experience as an F&B Server, Waiter/Waitress, or similar hospitality role is preferred.
• Previous experience in a luxury hotel, resort, lifestyle hotel, or high-quality restaurant environment is an advantage.
• Good knowledge of food and beverage service standards.
• Basic knowledge of food safety, hygiene, and allergens.
• Good spoken English; additional languages are an advantage.
• Experience using a POS system is an advantage.

What's in it for you...

• The opportunity to join an innovative, fast-growing, international group that’s committed to not just building new hotels but building a global brand.
• The chance to challenge the norm and work in an environment that is both creative and rewarding.
• Become part of a team that’s very passionate about creating great hospitality experiences and exploring new locations at every opportunity.
• A competitive package and plenty of opportunity for development.
• Excellent discounts across the entire Ennismore family of brands.

Working at Our Habitas means being part of a purpose-driven movement. You will help shape stories that go beyond rooms and amenities, creating emotional experiences and connecting people through shared rituals, culture, and a sense of belonging.

If you believe in luxury that speaks to the soul, and want to build something meaningful in two of Middle East's most extraordinary destinations, we’d love to meet you.

jobs.title: Technicien de maintenance (H/F)
jobs.description:
Rattaché au Responsable Technique ou à son représentant, vous contribuez au bon fonctionnement, à l'entretien, et à la rénovation de l’Hôtel, de ses dépendances, annexes et installations (intérieurs et extérieurs) dans le respect des règles de sécurité en vigueur et des délais de réalisation qui vous sont donnés.

MISSIONS :

Maintenance préventive et corrective :

• Assurer la maintenance générale de l’Hôtel, de ses dépendances, annexes et installations, y compris à la résidence Monte Carlo.
• Effectuer des contrôles réguliers des installations (électricité suivant habilitation, plomberie, chauffage, climatisation, piscine, etc.).

• Diagnostiquer rapidement les pannes et dysfonctionnements (électriques, mécaniques, de plomberie, etc.) et réaliser les réparations nécessaires dans les plus brefs délais.
• Assurer les branchements informatiques simples.

Remise en état :

• Participer activement aux travaux de rénovation et de remise en état des espaces intérieurs et extérieurs, jardins compris, en collaboration avec l'équipe technique.

Mise en place technique des séminaires :

• Assurer le branchement des plateaux techniques : PC vers les systèmes de projection, mise en place des micros, réglage de la sonorisation pour garantir le bon déroulement des événements.

Accompagnement des prestataires extérieurs :

• Collaborer avec les prestataires externes et les encadrer lors de leurs interventions lorsque c’est nécessaire.

Maîtrise des énergies :

• Participer à la gestion énergétique du site en veillant à l'optimisation des systèmes techniques et en s’assurant de l’extinction des différentes zones inoccupées

Peinture :

• Assurer l'entretien et la rénovation de tous les éléments de peinture ou de papiers peints de l’Hôtel, de ses dépendances, annexes et installations (murs, plafonds, boiseries, etc.), y compris les retouches, les finitions et les travaux d'embellissement.
• Assurer l’entretien et le remplacement des sols souples ou durs et du mobilier (vernissage, peinture…).
• Maitriser les techniques de peinture sur les surfaces

Gérer les interventions :

• Répondre aux demandes d’intervention des différents services de l’Hôtel.
• Prioriser les urgences et planifier les interventions en fonction des besoins.
• Participer à l’installation et à la mise en service des nouveaux équipements.

Collaborer avec les équipes :

• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec le personnel de l’Hôtel pour garantir le bon fonctionnement des services.

• Former le personnel sur l’utilisation correcte des équipements.

Gestion des stocks :

• Contribuer à la gestion des stocks de matériaux, produits techniques, pièces de rechange, etc… s’assurer notamment de répondre aux besoins en peinture et en maintenance générale.

Hygiène, Sécurité et Santé au Travail :

• Assurer le respect des normes de sécurité et d’hygiène en vigueur.

• Participer à l’amélioration continue des processus de maintenance.
• Prendre soin du matériel mis à la disposition de service et signaler toute défectuosité à sa hiérarchie.
• Connaître et appliquer les conduites à tenir en cas d’évacuation incendie.

Suivi des interventions et reporting :

• Mettre en œuvre le Plan de maintenance préventive, en assurer la traçabilité et le suivi des opérations selon les procédures définies (vérifications des installations, tests de fonctionnement…)
• Rendre compte de l'avancement de vos missions à votre hiérarchie.
• Tenir à jour les registres de maintenance/technique et les rapports d’intervention.
• Faire les relevés quotidiens et mensuels (piscine, chaufferie…).
• Utiliser HOPR pour la gestion de vos missions au quotidien.

Formation :

• Participer aux formations nécessaires à l’exercice des missions : hygiène et sécurité, montage échafaudage…

COMPETENCES ET QUALITES REQUISES SUR LE POSTE :

Savoir-faire :

• Expertise confirmée dans les techniques de peinture et de décoration (préparation des surfaces, application, finitions).
• Connaissances générales en maintenance et capacité à intervenir sur d'autres installations techniques (chauffage, plomberie, électricité de base, climatisation).
• Polyvalence : Ouverture à la formation continue pour développer des compétences complémentaires, notamment en électricité ou en CVC.

• Formation en peinture polyvalente ou technique équivalente.
• Expérience en tant que peintre avec des compétences développées dans la maintenance.
• Compétences en électricité de base, avec une formation spécifique à l'Hôtellerie.

Savoir-Être :

• Dynamique.
• Organisé.
• Réactif.
• Autonome.
• Montrer l’exemple.
• Sens aigu du service : être à l’écoute des équipes et des clients.
• Excellente présentation et aisance relationnelle.
• Bonne communication en anglais.

SPECIFICITES DU POSTE :

• Travail en hauteur dans les règles

• Horaires variables et tournants du Lundi au Dimanche
• Permanence les week-ends et jours fériés.

• Capacité à travailler efficacement en équipe et sens de l’initiative
• Excellentes aptitudes à communiquer, à l’oral comme à l’écrit
• Horaires variables et tournants à raison de 39 heures par semaine, sans coupure

jobs.title: Growth Marketer
jobs.description:
ABOUT SIMPLE

Simple AI http://usesimple.ai is building state of the art voice AI agents for enterprise. Our realistic agents help iconic businesses like Doordash, xAI, and Omaha Steaks handle all kinds of phone operations, from customer support to order intake to lead qualifications. We are growing revenue like crazy and looking for a founding growth marketer to build a repeatable demand-generation engine and accelerate our next stage of growth. We are very excited about the potential for AI to change the world, and work out of our SF based office.

Simple AI raised $14M from world-class investors and operators like Y Combinator, First Harmonic, Massive Tech Ventures, Michael Seibel, Jared Friedman, Alexandr Wang, Matt Van Horn, Suhail Doshi, and Scott Wu.

 


THE TEAM

The founders (Catheryn https://www.linkedin.com/in/catherynli/ and Zach https://www.linkedin.com/in/zach-kamran/) met while running software teams at YC, where they shipped tons of new products for YC founders, including YC’s co-founder matching site. Cat previously worked at Instagram and Facebook and earned degrees in math and computer science at MIT. Zach previously studied computer science and statistics at U Chicago and led software at PEAK6. We have grown into a strong team of 20+ and are continuing to scale quickly.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Growth Marketer to build and scale Simple AI’s demand-generation engine. You will own performance marketing and paid acquisition, turning campaigns into qualified pipeline and revenue from enterprise customers.

You will launch, optimize, and scale paid search, paid social, and retargeting campaigns, while testing out-of-home opportunities such as billboards and transit ads. From audience targeting and creative briefs to landing pages, budget allocation, and measurement, you will own campaigns end to end.

This is a hands-on, analytical role for someone who likes running experiments and connecting results to business outcomes. You will work closely with sales and our content and creative team to improve conversion, identify what works, and scale the channels that drive growth.

 


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive salary & meaningful equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms

 - An office located in SF

 - Health, dental & vision insurance

 - Free lunch & dinner at the office

 - Late night Ubers

 - Regular team events & offsites
   
    


WHAT YOU'LL NEED

 - Have hands-on growth or performance marketing experience at a B2B SaaS, AI, or technical company.

 - Have personally launched and optimized paid campaigns on platforms such as Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, or Meta Ads.

 - Can manage budgets and improve acquisition efficiency, with a track record of generating qualified leads and pipeline.

 - Are comfortable with attribution, funnel analysis, and metrics such as conversion rate, customer acquisition cost, and return on ad spend.

 - Can design and run structured experiments across audiences, creative, landing pages, and channels.

 - Have strong creative judgment and can partner with content and design to turn ideas into effective ads.

 - Can independently take campaigns from idea to launch, work closely with sales, and prioritize based on results.
   
    


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with AI, contact center, customer support, sales automation, enterprise workflow, or technical SaaS products.

 - Experience planning or measuring out-of-home campaigns, including billboards, transit ads, or other creative offline placements.

 - Experience building a demand-generation program from the ground up at an early-stage startup.

 - Familiarity with CRM, marketing automation, and analytics tools that connect campaign spend to sales pipeline and revenue.

 


IF YOU'RE EXCITED TO BUILD AND SCALE THE GROWTH ENGINE BEHIND A FAST-GROWING AI STARTUP, WE'D LOVE TO CHAT.

Please note: At this time, Simple AI is unable to provide employment visa sponsorship for this role. We appreciate your interest and understanding.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant & Boston Office Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT LIQUID AI

Spun out of MIT CSAIL, we’re building AI systems that run where others stall: on CPUs, with low latency, minimal memory, and maximum reliability. We partner with global enterprises across consumer electronics, automotive, life sciences, and financial services. We’re scaling rapidly and want exceptional people to help us get there.




THE OPPORTUNITY

Our Co-Founder & Chief Science Officer, Alexander Amini, leads Liquid’s research agenda while working across the company and engaging with partners, academia, and the wider AI community. This role is his dedicated Executive Assistant — owning his calendar, travel, and preparation so his time goes to the highest-leverage work. You’ll be the operational layer around one of the busiest diaries in the company.

Alongside that, you’ll run our Boston office end to end. This is a deliberately broad role: one hour you might be restructuring a week of research and partner meetings, the next you’re managing a vendor, welcoming a visitor, or setting up for an evening event.

You’ll own the space, the vendors, the budget, and the day-to-day experience of everyone who walks through the door — employees, new hires, partners, and visitors.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Someone who:

 - Owns the diary, not just the calendar: You understand the “why” behind every meeting, protect time for deep work, and make judgment calls on what gets in and what doesn’t.

 - Anticipates before being asked: You review the week ahead, spot gaps in preparation, surface conflicts, and make sure the right materials are ready before anyone requests them.

 - Operates across audiences: You’re equally comfortable coordinating with senior external partners, world-class researchers, and building management.

 - Takes ownership of the physical space: You treat the office as a product — you notice what’s broken, low, or off before anyone else, and you fix it without being asked.

 - Thrives in ambiguity: Priorities shift, schedules change, and new workstreams emerge. You treat these as puzzles to solve, not disruptions to endure.

 - Has no task too big or too small: You take as much pride in the details of a Tuesday as in a flawless offsite.
   
   


THE WORK

Executive Support (CSO)

 - Own and manage a complex, fast-moving calendar: filtering requests, aligning with strategic priorities, and protecting time for research and high-leverage external work

 - Prepare briefing materials, agendas, and context ahead of meetings, and track follow-ups and commitments afterward so nothing falls through the cracks

 - Coordinate domestic and international travel, including conferences, speaking engagements, and partner visits

 - Act as a trusted point of contact for internal and external stakeholders seeking time with the CSO

 - Provide backup coverage for other executive assistants when needed
   
   

Boston Office Management

 - Own day-to-day operations of the Boston office: supplies, kitchen and catering, mail and deliveries, seating, and workspace upkeep

 - Manage facilities vendors and building management relationships, including contracts, service issues, and access/badging

 - Be the on-site point of contact for the office — the first face for visitors and the person employees go to when something needs sorting

 - Support new hire first days on-site: desk setup, equipment coordination with IT, and a proper welcome

 - Own the partner and visitor experience: logistics, preparation, and atmosphere for high-value engagements at the Boston office

 - Plan and run Boston office events, team socials, dinners, and offsites, including vendor sourcing and budget management

 - Manage the office and events budget, tracking spend and flagging variances

 - Travel occasionally (3–5 times per year) for events
   
   


DESIRED EXPERIENCE

Must-haves:

 - Experience supporting senior executives in fast-paced/high-growth tech or research environments, with demonstrated ability to take initiative and operate beyond core administrative tasks

 - Office management or facilities coordination experience, including vendor and budget ownership

 - Complex calendar and travel coordination experience, ideally for a leader with heavy external and speaking commitments

 - Strong business context awareness: you understand the “why” behind meetings, not just logistics, and can flag when priorities conflict

 - Event planning and vendor management experience

 - Ability to work in the Boston office 5 days per week — this is an in-person role by design

 - Skilled in Google Workspace
   
   

Nice-to-have:

 - Experience supporting a technical, research, or academic leader

 - Experience hosting external partners or clients in professional settings

 - Experience standing up or scaling office operations in a growing company

 - Slack experience
   
   


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN YEAR ONE

 - The CSO’s calendar is structured around research and high-leverage external activities, giving him back hours each week

 - Nothing slips: meetings are prepared, follow-ups are tracked, and stakeholders trust you as the route to his time

 - The Boston office runs itself as far as anyone can tell — functional, welcoming, and a place people want to work from

 - Boston events run smoothly and on budget, and partner visits consistently leave a strong impression
   
   


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Access: Direct exposure to a co-founder and the research leadership of a frontier AI lab; a vantage point into high-stakes decision-making

 - Compensation: Competitive base salary with equity in a unicorn-stage company

 - Health: We pay 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for you and your dependents

 - Financial: 401(k) matching up to 4% of base pay

 - Time Off: Unlimited PTO plus company-wide “Refill” days

 - Environment: Catered lunches, commuter benefits, and a culture that values deep work

A motivated Leasing Consultant for our Apartment Community in Falls Church, VA.

We're looking for you

To primarily work on all aspects of our onsite apartment leasing. Your efforts will be to handle incoming calls as well as online and in person traffic, lease apartments and prepare leasing files for approval and renewals.

jobs.title: Principal Agent Strategy Manager, Health Systems
jobs.description:
Building Healthcare That Remembers 

Every time you call a doctor's office, the system forgets you the moment you hang up. You wait on hold, explain everything from scratch, get bounced between lines, and hope someone follows up. Everyone has felt this. No one should have to. 

At Assort Health, we're building one continuous conversation for every patient. An AI agent that knows who you are, remembers how you like to be reached, and carries that context from your first symptom to your full recovery. What began as the first voice AI agent to schedule a specialty appointment has become the largest proprietary specialty dataset in healthcare: 270 million patient interactions, 62,000 care protocols, 1.6 million decision pathways. 

We went from 15 people in 2025 and will cross 250 by the end of 2026. Revenue is up 20x in 15 months and we've raised $222 million, including a recent $120 million Series C https://www.assorthealth.com/blog/assort-health-raises-120-million-series-c-to-scale-largest-deployment-of-ai-agents-for-the-patient-journey at a $1.2 billion valuation. We've also been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 and the 2026 Enterprise Tech 30 as the only healthcare AI company on the list!

Healthcare spends $1.1 trillion a year on administration instead of care. If you want to help change that, apply below.




THE ROLE

Assort Health is changing how health systems connect patients with care through AI. We’re hiring a Principal Agent Strategy Manager, Health Systems to lead our largest and most important healthcare partnerships.

You’ll work directly with executive, operational, clinical, and technology leaders to improve patient access and organizational performance. You’ll own complex relationships from launch through expansion while coordinating the teams responsible for delivering results.

This is a senior individual contributor role with meaningful influence across our customers, product, and Agent Strategy team.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own Assort’s largest healthcare accounts across the full customer journey.

 - Define outcomes, success measures, risks, growth opportunities, and plans for delivering ROI.

 - Guide leaders through complex decisions about AI, patient access, and operations.

 - Build alignment across executive, operational, clinical, and technology stakeholders.

 - Coordinate governance, decisions, timelines, and workstreams across Assort and the customer.

 - Protect retention, lead renewals, and identify meaningful expansion opportunities.

 - Bring health system insights into product, implementation, and business decisions.

 - Mentor other Agent Strategists and improve how the function supports healthcare customers.

 - Travel up to 25% for executive meetings, presentations, and customer work.




WHAT YOU BRING

 - 8+ years of relevant experience, including at least 5 years working in healthcare or health tech.

 - Experience owning large, high-value accounts across adoption, retention, renewal, and expansion.

 - Deep knowledge of healthcare operations, patient access, and how provider organizations make decisions.

 - Strong executive communication and the ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments.

 - Experience leading enterprise programs across multiple departments, workstreams, and senior leaders.

 - Strong product aptitude, analytical thinking, and the ability to learn technical healthcare products quickly.

 - The ability to influence without authority, mentor others, and improve how a team operates.

 - Sound judgment, clear prioritization, and comfort making decisions with limited information.




NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience helping customers adopt AI, automation, or other emerging technology.

 - Experience building customer programs or operating processes from the ground up.

 - Experience at an early-stage startup or rapidly growing company.




BENEFITS & PERKS FOR ASSORTIES

 - 💸 Competitive Compensation – Including salary and employee stock options so you share in our success.

 - 📚 Lifelong Learning – Annual budget for professional development, plus training opportunities to help you grow.

 - 💻 Office Setup Stipend – We’ll outfit your in-office workspace so comfy as it's productive.

 - 🩺 Top-Tier Health Coverage – Medical, dental, and vision insurance, because your health comes first.

 - 🏖 Flexible PTO – We trust you to take the time you need to recharge and come back ready to crush it.

 - 🥗 Meals & Snacks – Lunch, dinner, and snack breaks that fuel great ideas.

 - 💪 Fitness Stipend – Your wellness matters. We reimburse monthly membership costs to support your health.

 - 🚆 Commuter Benefits – We cover eligible transportation costs to make your trip to work easier.

 - 👵 401(k) – Build your retirement savings.
   
   


HOW WE WORK & WHAT WE VALUE

Our team at Assort Health moves fast, stays focused, and is fueled by a desire to serve our customers and patients. Our company values guide how we work—they are present in how we show up, make decisions and work together to move our mission forward. We bring a Day One Drive, relentlessly striving to improve, keep a 5-Star Focus, as our customers are our lifeblood, always Answer the Call, remembering that ownership and accountability are paramount, and show up with One Pulse, because we are one team, with one rhythm and one result. Our team is growing and we are looking for motivated, hardworking, and passionate talent. If you want to make healthcare accessible for everyone, we’d love to hear from you!

jobs.title: Seasonal Chef Instructor, Savory (Sur La Table)
jobs.description:
With over 58 stores and the largest avocational cooking program in the US, Sur La Table offers an unsurpassed selection of exclusive and premium-quality goods for the kitchen and table – and the culinary expertise and inspiration to go along with it. Whether the job entails interacting with our customers, driving digital growth, or providing vital behind-the-scenes support, we’re all here for the same reason – to roll up our sleeves and create happiness through cooking and sharing good food. 


Position Overview
As a Seasonal Chef Instructor, Savory at Sur La Table, you are the in-store expert and advocate for all things savory cooking. You deliver #bestincenter service, a company-wide standard for excellence in service, by sharing specialized knowledge in culinary techniques, cooking fundamentals, and personalized instruction that supports all company initiatives. The Seasonal Chef Instructor, Savory plays a key role in inspiring a love for cooking while driving sales of cookware, cutlery, and kitchen tools through hands-on savory classes and engaging culinary instruction.
 
Key Responsibilities
Customer Experience & Brand Representation
·        Represent Sur La Table’s brand and culture by creating memorable, educational experiences that inspire repeat visits and customer loyalty. 
·        Deliver exceptional in-store culinary experiences focused on savory cooking classes that reflect Sur La Table’s passion for food, teaching, and high standards, while following provided recipes and game plans to ensure consistency and quality.
·        Communicate technical cooking concepts and savory techniques in a clear, encouraging, and approachable manner.
·        Maintains expertise by staying current on products, actively engaging in available training, and independently seeking out additional resources.
Sales & Business Performance
·        Drive sales by upholding kitchen standards, encouraging second class sign-ups through strong customer engagement, and promoting retail items used or featured in class.
·        Deliver class revenue goals by ensuring high enrollment, positive reviews, and guest return rates.
·        Consistently meet or exceed culinary program goals by delivering exceptional classes that drive customer engagement and sales. Performance is measured by key KPIs such as second-class sign-ups, retail culinary product sales, and guest feedback through Google reviews.
Team Engagement & Store Support
·        Assist in setting up and breakdown of classes including organizing mise en place, prepping ingredients, and cleaning workstations.
·        Clean and sanitize dishes and equipment promptly to ensure smooth kitchen operations.
·        Assist with restocking, organizing, and maintaining kitchen supplies and tools to support overall store readiness.
Operations & Compliance
·        Ensure compliance with food safety standards, local health codes, and sanitation regulations.
·        Properly handle all tools, ingredients, and kitchen equipment to maintain a safe and efficient work environment.
·        Maintain accurate inventory levels, minimize shrink, and control supply and culinary expenses.
·        May handle liquor, wine, and beer in compliance with state and location alcohol regulations, company policies, including enforcing age restrictions.
·        Ensure store safety and cleanliness, addressing any maintenance needs promptly.
·        Adhere to applicable wage and hour laws.  Accurately records time worked according to SLT Policy.
·        Model and ensure consistent adherence to all Sur La Table policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
 
Physical Requirements
·        Ability to communicate verbally and work cooperatively with associates and customers.
·        Ability to remain standing for up to 4 hours at a time.
·        Ability to move about the store directing class participants while selling to customers and retrieving merchandise from stockroom or sales floor.
·        The capability to accurately perceive and differentiate variations in intensity or quality of flavors or odors, or to identify specific tastes or scents using the tongue or nose.
·        Ability to grab, reach, push, pull, bend, stoop, kneel and crouch to demonstrate, retrieve and/or replenish merchandise and/or cooking equipment.
·        Ability to use hands to seize, hold, grasp, turn, or otherwise to chop, whisk, slice, stir, juice and/or demonstrate other techniques.
·        Ability to lift and/or move merchandise weighing up to 50 lbs.
·        Ability to ascend/descend ladders to retrieve and/or move merchandise.
·        Ability to operate a computer, POS system, keyboards, merchandise scanners and mouse to accomplish work.
·        Available to work between 12 and 16 hours per week, with a flexible schedule, including nights, weekends, and holidays. While this is the minimum availability, scheduled hours may differ based on business needs.
·        Regular and predictable attendance with the flexibility to adjust class assignments based on demand.
·        Ability to work in a variable kitchen environment included but not limited to open flames, hot surfaces, temperature variations, various food allergens both physical and airborne.
 
Qualifications & Experience
·        Must be 21 years of age or older at the time of employment.
·        A degree in culinary arts is preferred; however, candidates with extensive culinary experience and demonstrated technical proficiency will be considered in lieu of formal education.
·        1-2 years of kitchen operations experience.
·        Valid Food Manager Certification.
·        Excellent communication, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
·        Passion for community engagement and providing exceptional customer experiences.

jobs.title: Book Keeper
jobs.description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a dependable and detail-oriented Bookkeeper to manage and maintain accurate financial records for our business. The ideal candidate will be organized, trustworthy, comfortable working with numbers, and familiar with accounting software such as QuickBooks.

Responsibilities

• Record and maintain daily financial transactions.
• Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable.
• Reconcile bank and credit card accounts.
• Prepare invoices and track customer payments.
• Process and record bills and business expenses.
• Maintain accurate financial records and documentation.
• Assist with monthly and year-end financial reports.
• Monitor cash flow and account balances.
• Maintain organized bookkeeping files and records.
• Assist the owner, accountant, or management with financial information as needed.
• Maintain confidentiality of company financial information.
• Bussiness & Personal Taxes Prepared

Qualifications

• High school diploma or GED required.
• Previous bookkeeping or accounting experience preferred.
• Knowledge of QuickBooks or similar accounting software.
• Basic knowledge of accounting principles.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.
• Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
• Ability to meet deadlines and work independently.
• Excellent communication and problem-solving skills.
• Must be trustworthy and able to handle confidential information.

Preferred Qualifications

• Bookkeeping or accounting certification.
• 1–2 years of bookkeeping experience.
• Experience with payroll and tax-related bookkeeping.
• Experience working with small businesses.

· Depth perception

· Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces

Temperaments

· The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgments and decisions

Physical Requirements including, but not limited to the following:

Standing

· Most tasks are performed from a standing position

Walking

· For short distances for short durations

Lifting

· Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck

· Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'

· Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72high

Carrying

· Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves

· Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store

· Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray

Pushing

· To move trays which are placed on dollies. A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24- 30 and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push

· Trays may also be pulled

Climbing

· Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance

Stooping/Bending

· Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station

· Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station

· Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day

· Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients

Crouching/Squatting

· Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas

Reaching

· Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward

Hand Tasks

· Eye-hand coordination is essential; use of hands is continuous during the day

· Frequently activities require use of one or both hands

· Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists

ADVANCEMENT

Many of our team members began their careers as delivery drivers and today are successful Domino's franchise owners. From customer service representative to management, General Manager to Manager Corporate Operations or Franchisee, our stores offer a world of opportunity.

DIVERSITY

Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize the unique talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an environment where all team members, because of their differences, can reach their highest potential.

SUMMARY STATEMENT

We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first!

JOB REQUIREMENTS

You must be 18 years of age or older.

General job duties for all store team members

• Operate all equipment.

• Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in cooler.

• Prepare product.

• Receive and process telephone orders.

• Clean equipment and facility approximately daily.

• Make and label boxes

Training

Orientation and training provided on the job.

Communication Skills

Ability to comprehend and give correct written instructions.

Ability to communicate verbally with customers and co-workers to process orders both over the

phone and in person.

Essential Functions/Skills

• Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator).

• Must be able to make correct monetary change.

• Verbal, writing, and telephone skills to take and process orders.

• Motor coordination between eyes and hands/fingers to rapidly and accurately make precise movements with speed.

• Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard or touch screen.

WORK CONDITIONS

Exposure to:

• Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when removing trash and performing other outside tasks.

• In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas.

• Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside.

• Fumes from food odors.

• Exposure to cornmeal dust.

• Cramped quarters including walk-in cooler.

• Hot surfaces/tools from oven up to 500 degrees or higher.

• Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts.

SENSING

• Talking and hearing on telephone.

• Near and mid-range vision for most in-store tasks.

• Depth perception.

• Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces.

TEMPERAMENTS

The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgments and decisions.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS including, but not limited to the following:

Standing: Most tasks are performed from a standing position.

Walking: For short distances for short durations.

Surfaces include ceramic tile bricks with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36 and 48.

Sitting

Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table.

Lifting

• Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.

• Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.

• Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72 high.

Carrying

• Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.

• Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.

• Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

Pushing

• To move trays which are placed on dollies. A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24- 30 and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.

• Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing

Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls and perform maintenance.

Stooping/Bending

• Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.

• Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.

• Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.

• Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Crouching/Squatting

Crouching or squatting may be performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

• Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.

• Workers reach above 72occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.

• Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.

• Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Hand Tasks

• Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day.

• Frequently activities require use of one or both hands.

• Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists.

• Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter.

• Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes.

• Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

Machines, Tools, Equipment, Work Aids

Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

PLEASE READ BELOW

Driving History

All persons must meet the following requirements in order to operate a motor vehicle for business purposes including, but not limited to, making deliveries:

• A person who is 18 years of age must possess proof of at least two years of driving history immediately preceding the date of the MVR evaluation.
• A person who is 19 years of age must possess proof of at least one year of driving history immediately preceding the date of the MVR evaluation.
• A learner’s permit period documented by an appropriate governmental authority may only be used to confirm driving history. We do not accept drivers who do not have an officially stated liscense.

DRIVING RECORD

All persons must meet the following requirements in order to operate a motor vehicle for business purposes including, but not limited to, making deliveries:

• No more than two driving-related violations (such as speeding, failure to yield, failure to obey traffic signals, careless driving, failure to wear a seatbelt,) in the two years immediately preceding the date of the MVR.
• No more than three driving related violations in the three years immediately preceding the date off the MVR.
• No more than one at fault accident in the three years preceding the date of the MVR.

If a person has any of the following violations they will be unable to driver for Domino’s.

• Leaving the scene of an accident.
• Hit and Run
• Reckless Driving
• Any driving violations involving drugs or alcohol.
• Vehicular homicide or assault
• Unlawful Racing and Exhibition Driving
• Eluding or Attempting to Allude an officer.

Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize the unique talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an environment where all team members, because of their differences, can reach their highest potential.

SUMMARY STATEMENT

We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first!

JOB REQUIREMENTS

You must be 16 years of age or older.

General Job Duties For All Store Team Members

· Operate all equipment.

· Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in cooler.

· Prepare product.

· Receive and process telephone orders.

· Take inventory and complete associated paperwork.

· Clean equipment and facility approximately daily.

Training

Orientation and training provided on the job.

Communication Skills

· Ability to comprehend and give correct written instructions.

· Ability to communicate verbally with customers and co-workers to process orders both over the phone and in person.

Essential Functions/Skills

· Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator).

· Must be able to make correct monetary change.

· Verbal, writing, and telephone skills to take and process orders. Motor coordination between eyes and hands/fingers to rapidly and accurately make precise movements with speed.

· Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard or touch screen.

Work Conditions

EXPOSURE TO

· Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when removing trash and performing other outside tasks.

· In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas.

· Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside.

· Fumes from food odors.

· Exposure to cornmeal dust.

· Cramped quarters including walk-in cooler.

· Hot surfaces/tools from oven up to 500 degrees or higher.

· Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts.

SENSING

· Talking and hearing on telephone. Near and mid-range vision for most in-store tasks.

· Depth perception.

· Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces.

TEMPERAMENTS

The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgments and decisions.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS, including, but not limited to the following:

Standing

Most tasks are performed from a standing position. Walking surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 4".

Walking

For short distances for short durations

Sitting

Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table

Lifting

· Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.

· Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.

· Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72" high.

Carrying

· Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.

· Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.

· Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

Pushing

· To move trays which are placed on dollies.

· A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24" - 30" and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.

· Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing

Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

Stooping/Bending

· Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.

· Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.

· Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.

· Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Crouching/Squatting

Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

· Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.

· Workers reach above 72" occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.

· Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.

· Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Hand Tasks

· Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day.

· Frequently activities require use of one or both hands. Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists.

· Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter.

· Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes.

· Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

Machines, Tools, Equipment, Work Aids

Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

During delivery of product, navigation of 5+ flights of stairs may be required.

Driving

Use safe driving practices to deliver products within a designated delivery area. Delivery drivers may make several deliveries per shift.

Stooping/Bending

Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station. Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station. Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day. Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients. Crouching and bending peformed occasionally to stock shelves and clean low areas.

Reaching

Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward. Workers reach above 72" occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves. Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes. Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Hand Tasks

Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day. Frequent activities require use of one or both hands. Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists. Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter. Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes. Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

Sensing

Talking and hearing on telephone. Depth perception as well as Near and mid-range vision required for most in-store tasks. Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces. Far and night vision required for driving
