jobs.title: Director Site Reliability Engineer, AI Infrastructure
jobs.description:
At d-Matrix, we are focused on unleashing the potential of generative AI to power the transformation of technology. We are at the forefront of software and hardware innovation, pushing the boundaries of what is possible. Our culture is one of respect and collaboration.

We value humility and believe in direct communication. Our team is inclusive, and our differing perspectives allow for better solutions. We are seeking individuals passionate about tackling challenges and are driven by execution.  Ready to come find your playground? Together, we can help shape the endless possibilities of AI. 



Role Overview

d-Matrix designs and manufactures purpose-built AI inference silicon, and the infrastructure underpinning our engineering organization must be as reliable and scalable as the chips we build. This role builds and leads d-Matrix's Site Reliability Engineering function from the ground up, owning the infrastructure that development, validation, and customer-facing deployments run on — spanning colocation facilities, on-premises lab clusters, cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), and customer-facing platform services. You will hire and grow the team, set technical direction, own SLOs for critical systems, and serve as the senior escalation point for incidents, all while remaining hands-on. You will partner closely with Software Tools, QA DevOps, and Engineering teams whose workflows run on this infrastructure, as well as Networking Operations and IT Operations, to drive reliability, cost efficiency, and the removal of technical debt.

What You Will Do

 - Build and lead the SRE function from scratch — define its charter, establish SRE as a discipline across hardware and software engineering, and hire, develop, and retain a team of 1–3 SRE engineers.

 - Direct a dedicated Data Center & Lab Technician team, setting work priorities and operational standards across on-premises and colocation facilities.

 - Own 24×7 reliability across colocation, on-premises lab clusters, cloud, and customer-facing platform services, designing for failure domains, progressive delivery, and strict change control.

 - Establish SRE process from zero: define SLIs/SLOs and error budgets, design on-call rotations (including a follow-the-sun model as d-Matrix expands globally), and build the incident and RCA management framework.

 - Own the full observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Splunk or equivalent), instrumenting metrics, traces, and logs for SLO visibility and alert design.

 - Drive IaC-first automation (Terraform, Ansible) and build self-healing infrastructure — host lifecycle automation, fleet auto-remediation, and AIOps-driven alerting.

 - Own FinOps and capacity planning across cloud, colocation, and on-premises tiers, including spend attribution, TCO modeling, and workload placement decisions.

 - Lead the migration from ad-hoc JBOD storage to an enterprise-grade shared storage platform spanning on-prem, colocation, and cloud, including architecture, vendor selection, and DR design.

What You Will Bring

 - Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field; 15+ years in SRE, infrastructure engineering, or production engineering.

 - 5+ years leading SRE or infrastructure engineering teams, including experience building or significantly rebuilding a function, not just managing a steady-state team.

 - Demonstrated track record of establishing SRE as a discipline in an organization that lacked it: defining SLOs, creating on-call frameworks, standing up observability, and driving cultural change with teams coming from a reactive ops background.

 - Deep Linux systems expertise: bare-metal operations, enterprise shared storage platforms (NAS/SAN, NFS/SMB at scale, snapshot and replication architectures), and hybrid-cloud storage integration.

 - Proven experience operating colocation and on-premises hardware at scale: server lifecycle, power and cooling awareness, rack-level networking.

 - Hands-on Infrastructure as Code fluency with Terraform and Ansible at production scale — module design, remote state, environment isolation, and change governance.

 - Kubernetes cluster operations: lifecycle management, workload reliability, storage, and RBAC at scale.

 - Full observability stack ownership (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog and/or Splunk or equivalent) for SLO definition, alert design, and end-to-end signal quality.

 - Strong Python and/or Go scripting for production services and automation that safely touches real infrastructure.

 - Executive communication skills, translating infrastructure health and operational risk into clear narratives for senior leadership, including non-technical stakeholders.

 - Ability to operate in a high-ambiguity, low-process environment, building structure rather than inheriting it.

Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience operating customer-facing infrastructure or platform services, with reliability expectations beyond internal tooling.

 - Knowledge of high-speed interconnect fabrics (InfiniBand, RoCE, or NVLink) — setup, troubleshooting, and performance tuning.

 - HPC job scheduler experience (Slurm, LSF, or equivalent) — setup, tuning, and integration with infrastructure automation.

 - Multi-cloud hybrid operations across AWS, Azure, and GCP alongside on-prem/colo, with unified observability and IaC.

 - FinOps expertise: cloud spend attribution, TCO modeling across cloud vs. on-prem vs. colo, and translating cost data into workload placement recommendations.

 - ITIL knowledge or an equivalent structured incident/problem/change management framework.

 - Published technical writing, conference talks, or open-source contributions in reliability, observability, or HPC infrastructure.

Equal Opportunity Employment Policy

d-Matrix is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and affirmative action employer. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcomed and empowered to do their best work. We hire the best talent for our teams, regardless of race, religion, color, age, disability, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, ancestry, genetic information, marital status, national origin, political affiliation, or veteran status. Our focus is on hiring teammates with humble expertise, kindness, dedication and a willingness to embrace challenges and learn together every day.

d-Matrix does not accept resumes or candidate submissions from external agencies. We appreciate the interest and effort of recruitment firms, but we kindly request that individual interested in opportunities with d-Matrix apply directly through our official channels.  This approach allows us to streamline our hiring processes and maintain a consistent and fair evaluation of al applicants. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.

jobs.title: Director of Strategic Finance
jobs.description:
OleOle is seeking a Director of Strategic Finance to build and own the financial model behind a global football platform with multiple interconnected businesses.

This is not a traditional accounting or controllership role. We are looking for someone who can take a complex platform strategy and translate it into a rigorous, investor-grade financial model that demonstrates how OleOle’s businesses develop individually and collectively as the platform scales.

Your first major responsibility will be building the OleOle master financial model. The model will examine the business at approximately 50 million, 100 million and 400 million global users, allowing assumptions around adoption, engagement, transaction volume, pricing, margins and penetration to change dynamically across the ecosystem.

You will build detailed economic models for OleOleSport ticketing, travel and VIP hospitality; Bad Monkey, our planned hybrid fixed-odds and prediction-market gaming business; Mini Programs and third-party commerce; sponsorship and commercial partnerships; and NewZeros, OleOle’s planned financial infrastructure encompassing payments, wallets, transaction processing and exchange capabilities.

NewZeros represents a particularly important long-term opportunity. The model must go beyond conventional exchange economics to examine what happens if OleOle’s financial infrastructure participates in payments and transactions generated throughout an ecosystem serving tens or potentially hundreds of millions of users.

OleOleSport requires a different approach. Because ticketing, travel and hospitality can potentially generate revenue before OleOle develops a large social audience, you will build a detailed bottom-up model for this business and help demonstrate its role as an early commercial engine.

You will also model OleOle’s capital requirements, cash utilization, operating expenses, unit economics, gross margins and long-term profitability. The objective is not to manufacture aggressive revenue projections. It is to create a defensible model in which management and investors can change assumptions and immediately understand their effect on the business.

You will work directly with the Founder & CEO and, as the company grows, with our CFO and business-unit leadership. The financial model you create will become a permanent management and fundraising tool and will evolve as actual operating data replaces assumptions.

Following funding, this role will continue as a senior member of OleOle’s finance organization, owning strategic planning, forecasting, budgeting, business-unit economics, KPI development, scenario analysis and financial reporting while helping build the company’s broader finance function.

We are looking for someone with exceptional financial modeling and analytical ability who understands how to model businesses such as marketplaces, payments, fintech, exchanges, gaming, consumer platforms or other transaction-driven businesses. Experience in investment banking, strategic finance, growth-stage technology, private equity, venture-backed companies or similarly rigorous financial environments would be particularly relevant.

The right person must be comfortable starting with ambiguity. OleOle is creating businesses that do not fit neatly into a conventional SaaS model. You will be expected to understand how each economic engine actually works, challenge assumptions, identify missing variables and construct the financial framework from the ground up.

This is ultimately the person who turns our vision into numbers sophisticated investors can interrogate.

OleOle is currently being built by a team working under deferred compensation while we complete our funding. This is not an unpaid or volunteer position: compensation is agreed upon in writing and accrues during the deferred period, becoming payable following funding. Once funded, this role will transition to a traditional compensation structure including a competitive salary, equity ownership and participation in the OleX token program. We are looking for someone who understands the realities of building an ambitious company before institutional funding and wants to remain with OleOle as the company grows.

Qualifications

• 10+ years of progressive experience in strategic finance, investment banking, private equity, growth equity, corporate development, venture-backed technology, fintech, payments, marketplaces, gaming, exchanges or other transaction-driven businesses.
• Exceptional financial modeling skills, with demonstrated experience building complex, multi-business operating models from the ground up rather than maintaining models created by others.
• Experience building integrated financial models encompassing revenue drivers, unit economics, transaction volume, gross margin, operating expenses, cash flow, capital requirements, scenario analysis and long-term profitability.
• Demonstrated ability to model businesses at significant scale, including scenarios involving tens or hundreds of millions of users, large transaction volumes, multiple geographies and multiple interconnected revenue streams.
• Deep understanding of payments and financial-network economics, including transaction volume, take rates, basis-point economics, merchant payments, wallets, cross-border transactions, payment-processing costs and network effects.
• Strong understanding of marketplace and platform economics, including GMV, buyer/seller participation, merchant adoption, transaction frequency, take rates, contribution margins and network effects.
• Experience with exchange or trading economics, including trading volume, liquidity, spreads, transaction fees and the economics of operating financial marketplaces.
• Experience with gaming, sports betting or prediction-market economics is highly desirable, particularly an understanding of fixed-odds betting, hold, liquidity, market making, prediction markets, gaming taxes and jurisdiction-specific economics.
• Experience evaluating or modeling consumer internet/social platforms at substantial scale, including user acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, cohort behavior and monetization.
• Ability to build sophisticated scenario models in which assumptions can be dynamically changed and flow through individual business units and consolidated company financials.
• Demonstrated experience producing financial models and investment materials capable of withstanding scrutiny from institutional investors, venture capital firms, private equity firms, investment banks, family offices and sophisticated financial counterparties.
• Experience supporting significant capital raises, M&A transactions, strategic investments, IPO preparation or institutional financing is strongly preferred.
• Ability to translate an ambitious strategic vision into measurable financial assumptions without confusing opportunity with forecast. Must be comfortable challenging founders and senior executives when assumptions cannot be financially supported.
• Strong understanding of three-statement financial modeling, valuation methodologies, discounted cash flow analysis, comparable-company analysis, sensitivity analysis, capital structure and financing scenarios.
• Advanced Excel and/or Google Sheets modeling skills are essential. Experience using SQL, Python, BI platforms, financial planning systems or AI-assisted financial analysis is highly desirable.
• MBA, CFA, CPA or advanced degree in finance, economics, accounting or a quantitative discipline preferred. Exceptional professional experience may substitute for formal credentials.
• Previous experience at a leading investment bank, private equity/growth equity firm, major fintech/payments company, global technology platform or highly successful venture-backed company would be particularly attractive.
• Experience working internationally and modeling businesses across multiple currencies, regulatory environments and geographic markets is strongly preferred.
• Must be capable of working directly with the Founder & CEO and senior technical/product leadership in an early-stage environment where significant portions of the business are still being designed.
• Must be willing to personally build the model. This is not a role for someone who has reached the point in their career where all detailed financial analysis is delegated to analysts.

Solutions not problems .

• Creative problem solver who can courageously propose and support new ideas to our organization. Not interested in best practices, lets build something better!
• Ability to adapt. An ideal candidate will welcome the opportunity to solve a broad range of problems using a wide array of technologies.
• Comfortable with ambiguity, shifting priorities and general growing pains of an early-stage technology company
• An exceptional entrepreneurial judgment that fosters independence over micro-management
• Understanding of football and international sports a huge plus

jobs.title: Origination Associate/ Senior Associate
jobs.description:
THE ROLE

At Flagship Pioneering, we don’t wait for the future—we build it. Our origination model is like a startup foundry for breakthrough science and technology: we dream up bold ideas, pressure-test them fast, and launch entirely new ventures from scratch. Think of it as startup creation in extreme mode—where the whiteboard is blank, the questions are audacious, and the upside is industry-shaping.

We are seeking a highly motivated and innovative individual to join our interdisciplinary team. As an Origination Associate / Senior Associate, you will contribute at the confluence of biology and technology —what matters is curiosity, creativity, and the drive to turn bold ideas into reality. You’re excited not just to invent products, but to help create entirely new companies from the ground up.

The individual will ideate/research/refine novel venture hypotheses, develop the scientific roadmap and business case and, and co-lead new company origination from the very early stage. You will play a central role in company creation, driving every aspect of venture origination—from identifying and recruiting key scientific partners and advisors, to establishing foundational intellectual property, building and leading the early scientific team, and shaping the company's culture and operating principles. In this role, you will collaborate closely with stakeholders across the Flagship ecosystem, leveraging the breadth of Flagship's expertise and capabilities to accelerate company formation and growth. A successful candidate will be a strategic thinker with keen acumen on value creation in biotechnology and an entrepreneur comfortable with technical and business uncertainty.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Explore white spaces: Identify and investigate emerging frontiers in biology and technology that could unlock entirely new markets and industries

• Hypothesize & stress-test: Generate bold venture hypotheses, run rapid experiments (conceptual, computational, or prototype-driven), and rigorously pressure-test assumptions

• Design venture blueprints: Help translate early-stage concepts into venture designs—including technical thesis, experimental planning, product architecture, and potential go-to-market approaches

• Shape new companies: Contribute directly to the conception and launch of high-potential ventures, with a hands-on role in their earliest stages.

• Collaborate across disciplines: Work closely with scientists, product thinkers and entrepreneurs to fuse technical insights with market potential

• Synthesize insights: Translate complex information into clear, actionable insights for Flagship’s venture creation process

• Push the frontier: Stay ahead of emerging scientific advances, bringing creativity and critical thinking to areas others overlook

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS

• Advanced degree (PhD or equivalent experience) in a scientific field — particularly among biology, bioengineering, chemistry and related disciplines. We welcome diverse academic backgrounds that bring new ways of thinking

• 2+ years of experience in research, technology, startups, or other environments that demand both analytical rigor and creative problem-solving

• Proven ability to rapidly become conversant in new areas of science and capable of engaging thought leaders at the deepest level of technological understanding

• Strong communication skills, including the ability to craft compelling written narratives and presentations

• Excellent analytical skills and ability to synthesize & communicate complex information rapidly and effectively

• Proven ability to thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving, entrepreneurial contexts; able to prioritize, pivot, and push forward without a playbook

• Unmatched sense of urgency with willingness to go the extra mile to drive success

• Passion for growth and development, with clear demonstration of openness to both giving and receiving feedback and track record of acting on feedback

• Genuine passion for innovation, venture creation, and exploring uncharted technological spaces

LOCATION:  Cambridge, MA. This position is full-time, on-site.

About Flagship Pioneering:

Flagship Pioneering is a scientific innovation engine that invents and builds companies that change the world. We bring together the greatest scientific minds with entrepreneurial company builders and assemble the capital to allow them to take courageous leaps in human health, sustainability, and beyond.

What sets Flagship apart is our ability to advance biotechnology by uniting life science innovation, company creation, and capital investment under one roof in a way that is largely without precedent. Our team of scientists, entrepreneurial leaders, and professional capital managers are each aligned around an institutionalized process that enables us to innovate and create breakthroughs for the benefit of people and planet.
Many of the companies Flagship has founded have addressed humanity’s most urgent challenges: vaccinating billions of people against COVID-19, curing intractable diseases, improving human health, preempting illness, and feeding the world by improving the resiliency and sustainability of agriculture.

Flagship has been recognized twice on FORTUNE’s “Change the World” list, an annual ranking of companies that have made a positive social and environmental impact through activities that are part of their core business strategies, and has been named four times to Fast Company’s annual list of the World’s Most Innovative Companies.

jobs.title: Senior Flight Software Engineer

About Varda

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. Varda’s W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.

About This Role

The Senior Flight Software Engineer is responsible for determining how our spacecraft behaves and operates in orbit and building reliable software to ensure it happens. The team is responsible for all phases of development, starting from requirements capture through testing and flight operational support.

Responsibilities

• Develop reliable flight software that determine how the spacecraft, satellite bus, and reentry capsule operate throughout the entire mission.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Coding
jobs.description:
ABOUT HANDSHAKE

Handshake was founded on a simple belief that everyone deserves a path to a great career, regardless of where they went to school or who they know. Today, we power 25 million job seekers, 1 million+ employers, and 1,600 educational institutions.

In 2025, we started Handshake AI and built the fastest-growing AI data business in history. We work directly with frontier AI lab researchers to create evaluations, publish benchmarks, and push the boundary of data. We’ve grown from $0 to ~$1B run rate and pay ~$60M to over 30K individuals every month.

Why join Handshake now:

 - Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel

 - Partner hand-in-hand with world-class AI labs, Fortune 500 partners and the world’s top educational institutions

 - Work together with engineers, scientists, operators, and more from Palantir, Meta, Scale AI, and former YC founders

 - Build a massive, fast-growing business with billions in revenue

About Handshake AI

Human data is the core infrastructure to AI advancement. Frontier AI labs currently improve model capabilities with various data-intensive post-training techniques. We believe that data spend for AI training will increase by 3-5x in the next few years and continue for much longer as models take on new domains. Handshake AI supports all of the frontier AI labs, working on their most complex data at the largest scale.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help build the systems that power high-quality coding data and evaluations for next-generation AI models.

You’ll work on technically complex projects involving software engineering benchmarks, code review evaluation, agentic coding workflows, and developer-facing tools. You’ll combine strong engineering judgment with hands-on execution, designing reliable systems that enable teams to create, validate, and improve sophisticated coding datasets.

This is an opportunity to shape foundational infrastructure at the intersection of software development and AI. You’ll operate with significant ownership, collaborate closely with engineers and technical program leaders, and help establish the standards and tools that support our fastest-growing AI initiatives.




 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design, build, and operate scalable software systems for coding evaluation, data generation, and agentic development workflows.

 - Develop tools and services that analyze, validate, and improve AI-generated code.

 - Build reliable pipelines for code execution, testing, benchmarking, and quality measurement.

 - Partner with engineering, research, operations, and customer-facing teams to translate complex requirements into practical systems.

 - Drive technical decisions across architecture, APIs, data models, observability, and operational excellence.

 - Improve engineering velocity through reusable frameworks, automation, and developer tooling.

 - Lead projects from ambiguous problem definition through design, implementation, launch, and iteration.

 - Mentor engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and day-to-day collaboration.

 - Establish high standards for maintainability, correctness, security, and reliability.




DESIRED CAPABILITIES

 - 5+ years of professional software engineering experience.

 - Strong proficiency in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go, or another modern programming language.

 - Experience designing and operating production systems with meaningful scale, reliability, and performance requirements.

 - Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including testing, APIs, data structures, distributed systems, and observability.

 - Experience building developer tools, infrastructure, data pipelines, evaluation systems, or other technically complex products.

 - Ability to work effectively in ambiguous environments and break large problems into clear, executable plans.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical partners.

 - A track record of taking ownership and delivering high-quality results in collaboration with 

 


BONUS POINTS

 - Experience with AI/ML evaluation, coding agents, LLM applications, or developer productivity tools.

 - Familiarity with code execution sandboxes, GitHub workflows, CI/CD systems, or benchmark infrastructure.

 - Experience working with containerization, cloud platforms, databases, and distributed job orchestration.

 - Contributions to open-source software or a demonstrated passion for improving developer tools.

 - Experience partnering with research teams or customers to deliver technically rigorous solutions.

 


PERKS




Handshake delivers benefits that help you feel supported—and thrive at work and in life.
The below benefits are for full-time US employees.

🎯 Ownership: Equity in a fast-growing company
💰 Financial Wellness: 401(k) match, competitive compensation, financial coaching
🍼 Family Support: Paid parental leave, fertility benefits, parental coaching
💝 Wellbeing: Medical, dental, and vision, mental health support, wellness stipend
📚 Growth: Learning stipend, ongoing development
💻 Remote & Office: Internet, commuting, and free lunch/gym in our SF office
🏝 Time Off: Flexible PTO, 15 holidays + 2 flex days
🤝 Connection: Team outings & referral bonuses

Explore our mission, values, and comprehensive US benefits at joinhandshake.com/careers http://joinhandshake.com/careers.

WHY JOIN SUPER-SOD?

At Super-Sod, we’ve been growing grass—and growing careers—since 1892. What began as a small general store has evolved into a trusted name in turfgrass and one of the largest suppliers of sod in the nation. We encourage a collaborative culture and have been recognized as a Top Workplace by the Atlanta Journal-Constitution.  With a long-standing tradition of excellence, we're proud to continue growing strong!

WE PROUDLY OFFER:

Benefits are available to full-time employees working 30+ hours per week:

• Competitive Wages

• Flexible Paid Time Off

• Comprehensive health and wellness plans (medical, dental, vision, HSA, supplemental life, accident, hospital, and critical illness) Hourly Benefits Overview Salary Benefits Overview

• Access to Employee Marketplace

• Employer-sponsored discounts

• Health and Wellness programs

• Employee Assistance programs

Are you a hands-on leader who thrives in a fast-paced, customer-focused retail environment and isn’t afraid to roll up your sleeves, take on challenges, and lead a team? If you're ready to take ownership of operations, drive sales, and lead with purpose in a growing sod company, we are excited to have you join our team!

Using discretion and independent judgement, the Store Manager will establish and implement short and long-range objectives for the assigned location, oversee related functions and activities, and administer company policies and procedures.

Essential Functions

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

• Analyzes and organizes sales operations for location(s).

• Responsible for and oversees the delivery of products to all customers served by location.

• Prepares weekly sales reports based on previous week and sets goals for future.

• Represents the organization with all referral sources; customers, potential clients, partnering companies and vendors.

• Communicates as needed with outside sales and home office concerning new developments and/or problems.

• Responsible for review of sales goals to include customer call log, for confirmation of product delivery and ongoing customer satisfaction.

• Manages both customer and employee conflict and resolves complaints about or within the department.

• Responsible for and oversees products that are available at the store location for pick up and deliveries.

• Responsible for review of sales goals to include customer outreach through CRM to maintain and establish new customer relations.

• Works with internal admin and customer success team relative to sales tracking, performance review and location efficiency, as well as customer support and employee engagement.

• Participates in the interviewing, hiring, training, and firing of employees.

• Delegates referral process/coordination, staffing coordination, supply inventory, and oversees the completion of these processes.

• Opens and closes facility a minimum of 30 minutes before/after normal business hours.

• Responsible for daily and monthly inventory management, including waste containment.

• Generates weekly time and attendance schedules and reviews hours for payroll.

• Required and responsible for equipment operation, training and certification.

• Maintains storefront, displays and inside working areas to ensure workspaces are clean and accessible by employees and customers

• Performs other related duties as assigned.

Competencies

• Personal Effectiveness/Credibility.

• Ethical Conduct.

• Technical Capacity.

• Organizational Skills.

• Project Management.

Supervisory Responsibility

This position manages employees within the retail store and is responsible for the performance, management, and hiring of the employees within the location departments. Responsible for the interviewing, hiring, onboarding, training, and the termination of employees through proper processes.  Responsible for coaching, teaching, implementing, inspecting and upholding a safe culture and work environment at the location.

Work Environment

This job operates in a professional retail environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, digital filing systems and payment processing machines. The employee will be expected to work outside in all weather conditions and must have suitable clothing. They must have the ability and willingness to work in adverse conditions, not just including extreme weather but enclosed spaces and heights up to 8 feet. The employee will be expected to work around and with machinery that distributes loud noises and exhaust. Personal Protective gear is provided by the employer. This position does require handling and operating of heavy equipment which may introduce a high risk to slips, trips and falls.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.location: Rohnert Park, CA; San Francisco Bay Area, CA
jobs.description:
Heartflow is a medical technology company advancing the diagnosis and management of coronary artery disease, the #1 cause of death worldwide, using cutting-edge technology. The flagship product—an AI-driven, non-invasive cardiac test supported by the ACC/AHA Chest Pain Guidelines called the Heartflow FFRCT Analysis—provides a color-coded, 3D model of a patient’s coronary arteries indicating the impact blockages have on blood flow to the heart. Heartflow is the first AI-driven non-invasive integrated heart care solution across the CCTA pathway that helps clinicians identify stenoses in the coronary arteries (RoadMap™Analysis), assess coronary blood flow (FFRCT Analysis), and characterize and quantify coronary atherosclerosis (Plaque Analysis). Our pipeline of products is growing and so is our team; join us in helping to revolutionize precision heartcare.

Heartflow is a publicly traded company (HTFL) that has received international recognition for exceptional strides in healthcare innovation, is supported by medical societies around the world, cleared for use in the US, UK, Europe, Japan and Canada, and has been used for more than 750,000 patients worldwide.

The Data Analyst builds and maintains the business-facing layer of HeartFlow’s data platform — analytical applications, the reporting and visualization architecture, and the semantic model definitions that serve them. This is a hands-on technical role combining application development with business intelligence architecture: work product includes code that is version controlled, peer reviewed, and deployed through continuous integration, as well as the dashboards, reports, and interfaces through which the business consumes it.

The role builds on data warehoused in Amazon Redshift, contributing to the semantic model, the reporting and visualization architecture, analytical applications, and the data quality validation and access governance around them. You will work directly with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Production, Compliance, Customer Success, and Medical Education, translating business questions into engineered, reusable data products rather than one-off deliverables.

The role spans both engineering and business fluency. The same person who writes the application code is expected to sit with the stakeholder who will use it, understand the decision it supports, and stay with it through adoption and iteration. Work ranges from a governed dashboard consumed by sales leadership to a purpose-built application that replaces a manual process outright.

Job Responsibilities:

• Analytical Application Development: Design, build, and maintain business-facing analytical applications and interfaces using Python and JavaScript. Own the development lifecycle including requirements, design, implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing maintenance.

• Business Intelligence & Reporting: Develop and maintain the business-facing reporting and visualization layer within Tableau — calculated field and parameter logic, dashboard design, and publishing and permissions management — building on the data sources and extract strategy designed by the Analytics Engineering function. Design dynamic and fluid visualizations for a wide range of stakeholder groups across all user levels, and create relevant measures and KPIs covering commercial performance, business performance indicators, pipeline management, and ad hoc strategic initiatives.

• Semantic Model Development: Author and extend Cube semantic model definitions as version-controlled code, submitted through pull request review. Implement measures, dimensions, and views consistent with the function’s modeling conventions so that business metric definitions remain centrally governed and consistently consumed.

• CRM Data & Reporting: Design and maintain advanced reporting and analysis on Salesforce.com (SFDC) data, applying working knowledge of SFDC reporting structure, object-field relationships, and the varied dynamics of the system. Support business users in the effective use of CRM reporting.

• Engineering Practice: Work within the function’s engineering operating model: Git-based version control, branching strategy, pull request authorship and review, branch protection, and CI/CD through GitHub Actions. Participate in code review as both author and reviewer.

• Data Quality & Stewardship: Analyze and curate varied sources of data to address key business priorities. Maintain strong data integrity including routine QC and validation across the reporting and semantic suite, contribute to automated testing and data quality validation, and identify and escalate data defects in CRM and other source data consumed by function-owned systems.

• Data Governance: Administer role-based access control and row-level security for function-owned reporting and application assets in accordance with company data handling policy.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with wide-ranging cross-functional teams including sales and sales leadership, operations, customer success, marketing, finance, compliance, and medical education to facilitate data-driven decisions.

• Ad Hoc Projects: Utilize classic SDLC and Agile processes to plan, manage, and execute ad hoc initiatives supporting various stakeholder groups.

Skills Needed:

Required:

• Strong SQL, including the ability to write, optimize, and reason about queries against a cloud data warehouse and a semantic layer.

• Demonstrated experience writing and maintaining production code in Python, JavaScript, or a comparable language — including application development, not solely scripting or notebook work.

• Proven experience with full cycle dashboard development in Tableau, including calculated fields, parameters, dashboard design, and publishing and permissions, working against data sources designed by others.

• Strong grasp of variable and function-based calculations and the ability to design custom and dynamic metrics to shape and create various KPIs.

• Working knowledge of Salesforce.com (SFDC) reporting structure, object-field relationships, and the varied dynamics of the system.

• Git-based development workflow: branching, pull request authorship and review, and familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or equivalent).

• Experience creating dynamic and fluid modeling and visualizations for a wide range of stakeholder groups across all user levels.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills appropriate to the level of audience, including the ability to elicit requirements from non-technical stakeholders.

• Ability to be extremely agile and deadline focused with a high degree of quality.

• Natural problem solver.

Preferred:

• Familiarity with semantic modeling layers implemented as code (Cube, dbt Semantic Layer, LookML, or equivalent).

• Cloud data warehouse experience (Amazon Redshift or equivalent) as a consumer and modeler of warehoused data.

• Understanding of data access governance concepts, including role-based access control and row-level security.

• Data quality and validation practice, including QC methodology and automated testing concepts.

• Fundamental knowledge of object-oriented programming.

• Understanding of healthcare technology and commercialization.

Educational Requirements & Work Experience:

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent relevant work experience.

• 2+ years of experience in business intelligence, analytics, or software development, including hands-on development work.

• Experience with Tableau or equivalent BI software and Salesforce.com (SFDC).

• Demonstrated experience writing and maintaining code in Python, JavaScript, or a comparable language.

• Experience working within a version-controlled development workflow and a formal code review process.

• Experience creating custom variable-based logic functions.

• Experience with semantic modeling layers implemented as code a plus.

• Experience with curating, modeling, and handling large-scale data sets a plus.

• Healthcare, medical device, or other regulated industry experience a plus.

A reasonable estimate of the base salary compensation range is $110,000 to $140,000, and bonus. #LI-IB1

We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law. jobs.title: Spa Therapist
jobs.description:
The Spa Therapist is responsible for delivering exceptional spa and wellness treatments that promote relaxation, rejuvenation, and overall wellbeing while creating a warm, personalized, and memorable experience for every guest.

The role embodies the Our Habitas approach to wellbeing, connection, care, and meaningful experiences, ensuring treatments are delivered professionally, safely, and in accordance with established spa standards and guest preferences.

Key Responsibilities

Guest Experience & Treatments

• Welcome guests warmly and create a comfortable, relaxing, and personalized spa experience.
• Conduct appropriate guest consultations before treatments to understand individual needs, preferences, expectations, and relevant contraindications.
• Perform professional spa treatments, including massage, body treatments, facials, and other wellness services according to training, certification, and the spa treatment menu.
• Personalize treatments appropriately based on guest needs while maintaining established treatment protocols.
• Explain treatments and wellness recommendations clearly and professionally.
• Provide appropriate post-treatment advice and recommendations.
• Maintain guest privacy, dignity, confidentiality, and comfort at all times.
• Anticipate guest needs and respond promptly and thoughtfully to requests.
• Handle guest feedback professionally and immediately escalate concerns when necessary.

Spa Operations

• Prepare treatment rooms before each appointment and ensure they are clean, organized, comfortable, and fully stocked.
• Ensure treatment rooms are reset promptly and correctly after every treatment.
• Maintain appropriate levels of linens, amenities, oils, products, and treatment supplies.
• Assist with opening and closing procedures as assigned.
• Ensure spa equipment is used correctly and report any damage or maintenance requirements promptly.
• Support appointment flow and communicate effectively with the Spa Reception and Wellness Team to minimize delays and enhance the guest journey.
• Assist with inventory counts and advise the Spa Supervisor of low stock or replenishment requirements.

Hygiene, Health & Safety

• Maintain the highest standards of cleanliness, hygiene, sanitation, and personal grooming.
• Clean and sanitize treatment rooms, equipment, tools, and surfaces according to established procedures.
• Follow appropriate hand hygiene and linen-handling procedures.
• Understand treatment contraindications and ensure treatments are not performed when there may be a health or safety concern.
• Immediately report accidents, injuries, guest reactions, or health and safety concerns.
• Ensure all products, oils, chemicals, and equipment are stored and handled safely.
• Comply with applicable local health regulations and Company hygiene and safety standards.

Product Knowledge & Commercial Awareness

• Maintain excellent knowledge of the spa treatment menu, wellness experiences, products, packages, and promotions.
• Recommend appropriate treatments and retail products based on genuine guest needs rather than a purely sales-driven approach.
• Support spa revenue objectives through thoughtful treatment recommendations, upgrades, and retail sales.
• Ensure accurate recording of treatments and products used as required.
• Participate in product knowledge sessions and continuously develop technical and wellness knowledge.

Teamwork & Our Habitas Culture

• Work collaboratively with Spa, Wellness, Front Office, Experiences, Housekeeping, and other departments to create a seamless guest experience.
• Attend departmental briefings, training sessions, and meetings as required.
• Support colleagues during busy periods and contribute positively to the overall team environment.
• Demonstrate respect, empathy, professionalism, and cultural awareness when interacting with guests and colleagues.
• Embody the Our Habitas culture through authentic, warm, and meaningful interactions.
• Participate in resort activities, wellness initiatives, and special guest experiences when required.

Qualifications & Experience

• Recognized certification or qualification in Massage Therapy, Beauty Therapy, Spa Therapy, or a related discipline.
• Previous experience as a Spa Therapist, preferably within a luxury hotel, resort, wellness retreat, or similar hospitality environment.
• Professional competency in relevant massage and body-treatment techniques.
• Knowledge of anatomy, physiology, treatment contraindications, hygiene, and safe treatment practices.
• Additional certifications in specialized massage, facial, holistic, or wellness therapies are an advantage.
• Good spoken English and ability to communicate comfortably with international guests.
• Strong personal grooming and professional presentation.
• Flexible to work shifts, weekends, public holidays, and according to resort operational requirements.

What's in it for you...

• The opportunity to join an innovative, fast-growing, international group that’s committed to not just building new hotels but building a global brand.
• The chance to challenge the norm and work in an environment that is both creative and rewarding.
• Become part of a team that’s very passionate about creating great hospitality experiences and exploring new locations at every opportunity.
• A competitive package and plenty of opportunity for development.
• Excellent discounts across the entire Ennismore family of brands.

Working at Our Habitas means being part of a purpose-driven movement. You will help shape stories that go beyond rooms and amenities, creating emotional experiences and connecting people through shared rituals, culture, and a sense of belonging.

If you believe in luxury that speaks to the soul, and want to build something meaningful in two of Middle East's most extraordinary destinations, we’d love to meet you.

Northpoint Recovery Holdings, LLC began 2009 as Ashwood Outpatient and officially launched the Northpoint platform in 2015. Now celebrating 10 years of growth in 2025, Northpoint is a leading behavioral healthcare provider offering evidence-based treatment for adults with substance use and co-occurring disorders through the Northpoint Recovery brand, and mental health treatment for adolescents through Imagine by Northpoint. Operating under an in-network, commercial insurance model, Northpoint has grown exclusively through de novo expansion—from two facilities to twenty across the Western U.S.—with more planned in both existing and new markets. We’re guided by core values of humility, heart, inspiration, and conviction. Our mission is simple: saving lives and restoring relationships by helping people get their lives back, and treating every individual with empathy and respect.

POSITION SUMMARY:

As a key member of the Northpoint clinical team, the Medical Assistant – Clinical Support will provide direct clinical and operational support to the nursing and medical teams in the care of patients receiving residential substance use disorder treatment. The Medical Assistant will assist with the collection of patient information, vital signs, laboratory specimens, EKGs, medication-related duties as permitted by applicable law and certification, inventory management, and other clinical support activities. This position will work closely with Registered Nurses, Advanced Practice Providers, physicians, therapists, case managers, and other members of the multidisciplinary treatment team to promote safe, efficient, compassionate, and high-quality patient care. The Medical Assistant will support the nursing team by completing delegated clinical tasks within the individual's education, training, certification, competency, and applicable scope of practice. The Medical Assistant will promptly communicate changes in patient condition, abnormal findings, patient concerns, and other clinically significant observations to the appropriate licensed clinical staff.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES INCLUDE:

Clinical Support

• Interact routinely with patients, observe behaviors, and communicate significant observations or concerns to the nursing and multidisciplinary treatment teams.

• Obtain and accurately document patient vital signs, including blood pressure, pulse, respirations, temperature, oxygen saturation, weight, and other measurements as directed.

• Obtain and document patient information through structured interviews, questionnaires, and other approved data-gathering processes.

• Assist with collection of patient histories and other relevant information as directed by nursing or medical staff.

• Obtain laboratory specimens, including venipuncture and other specimen collection procedures, when appropriately trained and permitted by applicable law and company policy.

• Perform CLIA-waived testing as trained and competency-validated.

• Perform and obtain EKGs according to established procedures and communicate abnormal or concerning results promptly to the appropriate licensed clinical staff.

• Prepare patients for examinations and assist licensed clinical staff with examinations and procedures as directed.

• Accurately document clinical information and completed tasks in the electronic medical record.

• Monitor patients for observable changes in condition and promptly report significant findings, abnormal vital signs, behavioral changes, withdrawal symptoms, or other concerns to the appropriate RN or provider.

• Assist nursing staff with obtaining information necessary to support withdrawal management monitoring and other established clinical protocols. The Medical Assistant does not independently perform nursing assessments or exercise nursing judgment.

• Assist with patient admission, orientation, transfers, and discharge activities as assigned.

• Provide appropriate patient education and reinforcement of information within the Medical Assistant's training and scope, and refer clinical questions to the appropriate licensed staff.

• Maintain appropriate inventory levels of medical supplies, laboratory supplies, PPE, and other clinical materials.

• Monitor expiration dates and storage conditions of clinical supplies and report expired, damaged, or compromised supplies.

• Assist with coordination of appointments, laboratory services, follow-up care, and other patient needs as directed.

• Complete documentation accurately, professionally, and in a timely manner according to HIPAA, state laws, and Northpoint policies and procedures.

Medication Support

• Obtain and maintain QMAP certification when required by the position, applicable regulations, or facility requirements.

• Complete all required medication administration training and competency evaluations before performing medication administration duties.

• Administer medications only when legally permitted, appropriately delegated or authorized, and within the individual's current certification, competency, and scope of practice.

• Follow all medication administration procedures, including patient identification, medication verification, appropriate documentation, medication storage and security, and reporting of medication errors or adverse reactions.

• Immediately report patient complaints, adverse reactions, medication refusals, changes in condition, or other concerns related to medication administration to the appropriate licensed nurse or provider.

Laboratory and Diagnostic Services

• Perform venipuncture and laboratory specimen collection within the individual's training, competency, and applicable scope.

• Properly label, process, store, and transport laboratory specimens according to established procedures.

• Perform CLIA-waived testing after completion of required training and competency validation.

• Complete required quality control procedures and documentation for point-of-care testing.

• Perform EKGs according to established procedures and ensure results are appropriately documented and communicated.

• Report abnormal or unexpected laboratory, point-of-care testing, EKG, or vital-sign findings promptly to the appropriate RN or provider.

QUALIFICATIONS/REQUIREMENTS FOR POSITION:

• QMAP certification or the ability to obtain QMAP certification within the timeframe required by the Company required.

• Completion of an accredited Medical Assistant program preferred.

• Current Medical Assistant certification preferred

• Previous healthcare experience required; experience in behavioral health, substance use disorder treatment, residential treatment, detoxification, emergency medicine, or other inpatient settings preferred.

• Demonstrated competency in vital signs, patient interviewing, specimen collection, phlebotomy, and EKGs preferred.

• Current and nationally accredited CPR/First Aid/AED certification.

• Knowledge of computer and electronic medical record systems; experience with KIPU preferred.

• Enthusiasm, passion for working with people, and an internal drive to improve the lives of individuals in our care.

• Ability to work with a diverse patient population.

• Demonstrated ability to maintain strong personal boundaries while building rapport with patients.

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills.

• Ability to recognize and promptly report changes in patient condition.

• Demonstrated ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information appropriately.

• Must maintain all required certifications and credentials throughout employment.

• Must be at least twenty-one (21) years of age.

• Must have a valid driver's license and safe driving record

PREFERRED KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS:

• Excellent organizational abilities.

• Excellent written and oral communication skills.

• Attention to detail and accuracy.

• Patient service oriented, both internally and externally.

• Creative and persistent problem solver.

• Able to handle confidential material in a reliable manner.

• Ability to interact and communicate with individuals at all levels of the organization.

• Strong interpersonal skills to handle sensitive situations and confidential information.

• Ability to multi-task and prioritize workload in a fast-paced environment.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite.

• Knowledge or experience with substance use disorder treatment and withdrawal management.

• Knowledge of basic medical terminology.

• Knowledge of infection prevention and control practices.

FULL-TIME BENEFITS INCLUDE:

• Subsidized Health Insurance Coverage for Employee, Spouse, & Dependent(s)

• 100% Employer Paid Basic Life Insurance equal to 1x annual salary, up to $100,000

• 100% Employer Paid Employee Assistance Program

• Voluntary Dental, Vision, Short-Term Disability, Supplemental Life & AD&D, Critical Illness, Accident, and Hospital Indemnity Insurance.

• Pre-tax Savings Accounts for all IRS-allowable medical and dependent care expenses

• Generous Paid Time Off plan

• Employee Referral Bonuses

• 401K Retirement Plan & Employer Match

jobs.title: Principal Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
You know a great technical sale is about more than delivering a polished demo. The real work is understanding what a customer is trying to accomplish, figuring out whether Expel can actually solve it, and making sure what we promise during the sales process is exactly what our teams are prepared to deliver.

As a Principal Solutions Architect at Expel, you'll own the technical side of some of our most complex Enterprise opportunities. You'll lead technical discovery, demonstrate Expel's service, design and drive Proofs of Value (POVs), work through technical objections, and create the bridge between Sales and Delivery so customers aren't starting over once the deal is signed.

You'll need enough technical depth to comfortably navigate conversations across security operations, incident response, SIEM, endpoint, network, and cloud environments. But being the smartest technical person in the room isn't enough. We're looking for someone who can listen, ask great questions, tell a compelling technical story, challenge assumptions when necessary, and build trust with everyone from a SOC analyst to a CISO.

This is a Principal-level individual contributor role. You'll be expected to independently navigate our hardest opportunities, influence people who don't report to you, hold teams accountable when necessary, and help make the broader Solutions Architecture organization better along the way.

Sound like your kind of challenge? We'd like to hear from you.

What Expel can do for you

• Put you at the center of complex Enterprise security opportunities where your technical judgment can directly influence both the sale and the long-term customer relationship.

• Give you ownership across the technical sales lifecycle, from discovery and demos through POVs, technical objections, escalations, and the transition into service delivery.

• Expose you to a wide range of Enterprise security environments across SIEM, endpoint, network, cloud, identity, security operations, and detection and response.

• Connect you with experienced Account Executives, Sales leaders, SOC analysts, Detection & Response, Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Service Delivery teams.

• Give you the autonomy to solve difficult customer problems creatively while maintaining the integrity to be clear about what Expel can and cannot do.

• Give you the opportunity to influence how we run POVs, approach Enterprise opportunities, transition customers into delivery, and improve the overall Solutions Architecture motion.

• Let you remain deeply connected to customers and technical work while operating with Principal-level visibility and influence across the business.

What you can do for Expel

• Own the technical strategy for complex Enterprise opportunities from initial discovery through POV, onboarding, and the customer's first 30 days.

• Lead POVs end to end by defining meaningful success criteria, building the technical delivery plan, coordinating internal teams, troubleshooting issues, and keeping execution on track.

• Deeply understand the challenges bringing a prospect to Expel and clearly map those needs to what our service can and cannot solve.

• Deliver technical service demonstrations and tell a compelling story about how Expel creates security value, adapting your approach based on whether you're speaking with practitioners, executives, or somewhere in between.

• Act as a trusted technical advisor who can ask difficult questions, challenge assumptions, navigate technical objections, and tell a prospect or salesperson "no" when that's the right answer.

• Partner closely with Account Executives and regional Sales leadership on opportunity strategy, technical discovery, competitive positioning, RFPs/RFIs, and complex customer requirements.

• Prepare Delivery teams with the technical context, expectations, risks, environment details, and opportunities necessary for a smooth transition from pre-sales into service delivery.

• Own technical escalations that arise during POVs or the first 30 days of service, pulling together the right people and staying accountable until the issue reaches resolution.

• Coordinate across Sales, Product, Engineering, SOC, Detection & Response, Customer Success, and Delivery, influencing and holding stakeholders accountable even when they don't report to you.

• Maintain strong working knowledge across SIEM, endpoint/EDR, network, cloud, security operations, incident response, attacker behavior, and detection and response.

• Identify opportunities to improve our POV methodology, technical content, processes, customer handoffs, and internal enablement, then work across teams to actually implement those improvements.

• Raise the technical and consultative bar for the broader Solutions Architecture team by sharing what you learn and helping others navigate difficult customer and technical situations.

What you should bring with you

• 8+ years of relevant experience across Solutions Architecture, Sales Engineering, technical security selling, security consulting, security operations, incident response, or similar customer-facing security roles.

• A track record of operating at a senior or principal level, regardless of your current title. You can independently own complex Enterprise opportunities, influence stakeholders without formal authority, and become the technical person others trust when the answer isn't obvious.

• Meaningful experience leading complex Enterprise POVs, including technical discovery, defining success criteria, coordinating execution, managing objections, troubleshooting issues, and connecting technical outcomes back to customer goals.

• Strong security depth with the ability to confidently discuss security operations, incident response, attacker behavior, network architecture, cloud environments, SIEM, endpoint/EDR, and detection and response.

• The ability to understand how security technologies work together in real customer environments and identify where technology alone doesn't solve the underlying problem.

• Strong storytelling skills. You can take something technically complicated and make it understandable, relevant, and compelling for a SOC analyst, security engineer, Account Executive, or CISO.

• Trusted-advisor instincts. You look beyond what a customer initially asks for, uncover what they're actually trying to accomplish, and aren't afraid to respectfully challenge a proposed approach.

• Strong project and stakeholder management skills with experience coordinating complex work and holding others accountable without relying on formal authority.

• High EQ and the ability to navigate disagreement, conflicting priorities, and difficult customer conversations without losing trust.

• Genuine curiosity. You ask thoughtful questions, dig beyond surface-level answers, and continuously invest in understanding security, technology, customers, and the business.

• Coachability and a low-ego approach to feedback. You don't need to know everything, but you should want to keep getting better.

• A track record of improving processes, technical strategy, enablement, customer deliverables, or team practices beyond your own individual opportunities.

Bonus points for...

• Hands-on experience working in a SOC, incident response, threat hunting, detection engineering, or another security operations environment.

• Experience selling or delivering MDR, MSSP, SIEM, EDR/XDR, cloud security, or other security operations solutions.

• Experience supporting large Enterprise customers with complex environments, long sales cycles, and multiple technical and executive stakeholders.

• Experience working directly with Delivery or Customer Success after the sale rather than ending your involvement when the contract is signed.

• Experience responding to complex Enterprise RFPs and RFIs.

• Experience improving POV methodology, technical enablement, reusable content, or processes for a broader Solutions Architecture or Sales Engineering organization.

• A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related discipline.

Additional notes

This role is remote within the United States. While our office is located in Herndon, Virginia, we're open to candidates across the U.S. who can effectively support the customers, Account Executives, and regional stakeholders aligned to their territory.

Travel is expected to be up to 10-20% and may include customer meetings, executive briefings, conferences, roadshows, and visits to Expel HQ.

The targeted base salary range for this role is $186,000 to $195,000 USD, with a 75/25 pay mix resulting in targeted on-track earnings (OTE) of $248,000 to $260,000 USD, plus equity.

We believe in paying transparently and equitably. Your compensation will ultimately be based on factors such as your experience, skills, team equity, and market data. You'll also be eligible for unlimited PTO, which we model and encourage, work location flexibility, up to 24 weeks of parental leave, and really excellent health benefits.

We're only hiring those authorized to work in the United States. We do not currently sponsor immigration visas.

We're an Equal Opportunity Employer: You'll receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.

We'll ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please let us know if you need accommodation of any kind.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, (Multimodal)
jobs.description:
In 2026, we launched Computer, the defining product for the new era of agentic AI. We've scaled beyond the millions of people using Perplexity every day for research, shopping, investing and curiosity into a new paradigm of using AI to transform knowledge into action.



The Multimodal team builds the experiences and infrastructure that move AI interaction beyond touch and text: realtime voice, vision, and the platform systems behind them. We own the full path from a user speaking into a device to an answer coming back: the realtime session infrastructure that connects clients to frontier audio models, the backend orchestration that routes, records, and supervises live sessions, and the SDK that powers voice and multimodal experiences across Perplexity's apps.



As Engineering Manager for Multimodal, you will lead the team building realtime voice and multimodal experiences across Perplexity. You'll hire and develop engineers, set technical direction, and drive new products at the intersection of voice, vision, and agents.





KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

 - Lead the team building realtime voice and multimodal experiences across Perplexity, taking new products from first prototype to production launch.

 - Own the team's roadmap, deciding which voice and vision experiences to build next and what infrastructure they need to succeed.

 - Hire and develop engineers, giving them ownership of meaningful technical problems and the feedback to grow.

 - Shape the architecture behind the full voice experience, from a user speaking into a device to models, tools, and agents responding.

 - Lead the systems that turn live conversations into action, connecting voice models to tools, agents, and long-running tasks.

 - Guide the team through the latency, reliability, and scaling challenges of live voice, including session recovery and performance under load.

 - Partner with SDK, client, infrastructure, and model teams to turn new audio and vision capabilities into experiences people can use across our apps.

 - Use user feedback and production performance to improve the experience after launch and decide where the team should invest next.


QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience managing engineering teams, including hiring, coaching, and performance management.

 - A strong software engineering background in backend or distributed systems.

 - Experience designing and operating production services in rapidly scaling environments on AWS or similar cloud infrastructure.

 - A track record of leading teams to ship complex projects in a fast-moving environment.

 - Strong product judgment and the ability to translate user problems into clear technical priorities.

 - Clear communication and the ability to work effectively across teams.

 - Experience with Rust, Python, Go, or similar languages. We work primarily in Rust and Python.

 - Genuine interest and adoption of AI products and willingness to learn quickly.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with realtime media systems: voice, audio streaming, WebRTC, or low-latency transport.

 - Experience integrating LLMs, speech models, or computer vision into production systems.

 - Experience with agent frameworks, tool-calling architectures, or sandboxed execution environments.

 - Experience leading projects across backend services, client SDKs, and user-facing applications.

 - Time spent leading a team at a fast-growing startup or in a high-ownership environment.

jobs.title: Senior Detection & Response Engineer
jobs.description:
You're the detection engineer people turn to when they ask "what does Microsoft actually see here?" Not the marketing-slide answer, the real map. Which product emits which telemetry, any anticipated ingestion lags, what table or API it lands in, which license tier gates it, how long it survives before it ages out, and where the documentation quietly disagrees with reality. When a new technique drops, your first instinct is to ask which Microsoft signal would catch it, and whether customers have it switched on.

You also know Microsoft never sits still. Hunting tables appear, columns get renamed, Graph versions retire, capability shuffles between SKUs, previews go GA, features quietly vanish, and native alert logic shifts underneath you. You've got a repeatable way of staying ahead of that churn instead of finding out when a detection stops firing. You're comfortable behind a command line and in front of a customer, including scenarios where the conversation isn’t pleasant. If that's you, we'd love to talk! We have an amazing team and believe you'll love getting to know us.

At Expel, we help businesses bridge the cybersecurity talent gap by providing transparent Managed Detection and Response. To do this we build technology to make sure our security analysts are solving important problems, and automation is helping them make better decisions at every step. We delight in using technology to make security accessible for our customers.

What Expel can do for you

• Make you one of our recognized authorities on Microsoft detection and response — for our SOC, our engineers, our go-to-market teams, and our customers

• Give you real ownership of Expel's detection coverage across the whole Microsoft security estate

• Put Microsoft telemetry from across our customer base in front of you — a breadth of real-world environments no single enterprise gets to see

• Let you write and tune detections in our own rule engine and watch them run against live signal

• Treat AI tooling (Claude Code and friends) as a first-class part of how you work, not a side experiment

• Enable you to learn from analysts, data scientists, engineers, and responders responsible for various components of Expel's product and services

• Provide access to popular EDR, network, SIEM, identity, and cloud technologies well beyond the Microsoft stack

• Challenge you to push the boundaries of our security vision

What you can do for Expel

• Own our detection coverage across Defender XDR, Entra ID, Sentinel, Microsoft Graph, Azure, and Microsoft 365 — from raw signal through to shipped, tuned detections

• Build and maintain a living map of Microsoft security signal: what exists, known ingestion lag, where it lands, what gates it, how long it's kept, and how far you can trust it

• Track how that signal changes and turn every material change into a concrete action — catching drift before it costs us efficacy

• Tell us where Microsoft's native detections are strong enough to lean on, where they're noisy or shallow, and where Expel needs its own layer

• Make SOC analysts faster by automating Microsoft-specific investigative workflows against the Graph, Defender, Sentinel, and Entra APIs

• Partner with Engineering on our Microsoft integrations — ingestion, API limits and throttling, and schema mapping

• Answer the hard questions from the SOC, CS, and Sales — and mentor the people asking them

• Help customers understand what they're actually covered for, what they're missing, and what turning it on would buy them

What you should bring with you

• Deep, current, hands-on knowledge of the Microsoft security stack — Defender XDR (Endpoint, Identity, Office 365, Cloud Apps), Entra ID, Sentinel, Microsoft Graph, and the Azure and Microsoft 365 control and data planes

• Fluency in KQL: you can write, read, optimize, and debug non-trivial hunting queries across both Defender Advanced Hunting and Sentinel, and you know how and why the two schemas differ

• Working knowledge of the Graph and Graph Security APIs, the Defender and Sentinel APIs, and their authentication, permission, versioning, and throttling models

• A strong grasp of the Entra ID (and legacy Active Directory) identity attack surface — authentication flows, conditional access, OAuth application consent, token theft and replay, hybrid identity and sync, privileged role abuse — and the telemetry each produces

• Solid understanding of Windows internals and command line tooling, with enough macOS and Linux to keep up with Defender's cross-platform coverage

• Experience writing, deploying, and tuning custom detections against Microsoft data sets, plus enough non-Microsoft exposure (AWS, GCP, other EDR and SIEM) to keep perspective

• Proficiency with Python and Sigma, and real fluency using Anthropic tools such as Claude Code to work across systems and data (locally, via MCP, and so on)

• 5+ years in information technology or security operations, with substantial time spent defending or operating Microsoft environments

• Excellent tact and diplomacy skills — you can explain Microsoft's limits to an audience that doesn't want to hear about them

• SC-200, AZ-500, or SC-300 are a plus; demonstrated depth matters considerably more

Work Location

Our headquarters is in Herndon, Virginia. However, we realize that while there is a benefit to in-person interaction, good people don’t all live in Northern Virginia. Remote work is an option for this role.

Additional Notes

The base salary range for this role is between $142,900 USD and $207,200 USD + bonus eligibility and equity. While the full salary band reflects our long-term compensation framework, we're primarily targeting candidates between $160,000 and $192,000 based on experience, skills, and market data.

We believe in paying transparently and equitably. Your salary will ultimately be based on factors such as your experience, skills, team equity, and market data. You’ll also be eligible for unlimited PTO (which we model and encourage), work location flexibility, up to 24 weeks of parental leave, and really excellent health benefits.

We’re only hiring those authorized to work in the United States. We do not currently sponsor immigration visas.

We’re an Equal Opportunity Employer: You’ll receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.

We’ll ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please let us know if you need accommodation of any kind.

#LI-Remote

Salary Range

$142,900—$207,200 USD

jobs.description:

The Assistant Restaurant Leader is responsible for supporting the Restaurant Leader in day-to-day operations of the restaurant and upholding Raising Cane’s standards and culture in all areas of restaurant operations.
