Our culture blends the pace and agility of a fintech start-up with the impact, stability, and discipline of Wall Street. We encourage creativity and experimentation while ensuring institutional-grade execution and regulatory compliance in everything we do. Join us and help build the future of global investing!

About The Role

As the Manager of Site Reliability Engineering, you'll lead a team of SRE Automation Engineers while remaining a hands-on technical authority for our Brokerage-as-a-Service platform. This isn't a purely people-management seat, you're expected to bring the same principal-level SRE depth to automation design and engineering as an individual contributor, while also building the team, setting technical direction, and developing your engineers' careers.

This role is centered on reducing manual toil through engineering, applying Google's SRE principles: SLOs, error budgets, blameless postmortems, and systematic toil reduction, adapted to a regulated brokerage environment. You'll carry two responsibilities at once: driving the automation agenda, building and orchestrating workflows in Rundeck and Airflow to eliminate repetitive work, and growing your team of SRE Automation Engineers into a high-functioning automation practice. You'll guide the design of internal SRE platforms, automate complex workflows, and ensure our Kubernetes-based and colo ecosystems can handle the demands of global financial markets, while owning the people side of the team: mentorship, performance, and growth, and the day-to-day management of the team's Jira board. While this role includes participation in on-call rotations supporting our 24/7 global operations, your primary mission is to build systems that make manual intervention obsolete, and a team capable of sustaining that mission.

What You'll Do

• Team Leadership & Development: Manage, mentor, and grow a team of SRE Automation Engineers—setting technical direction, running 1:1s, owning performance management and career development, and managing the team's Jira board to prioritize and track sprint work.

• Engineering & Automation: Lead the design and development of internal tooling and automation—including Rundeck and Airflow-based orchestration—to eliminate repetitive manual toil and improve developer velocity, staying hands-on with the most complex, highest-leverage automation work yourself.

• SRE Practice & Governance: Adapt Google's SRE principles to our environment—defining SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets, and using them to guide engineering and operational priorities.

• Infrastructure as Code: Set architectural standards for modular, reusable IaC using Terraform and oversee GitOps workflows via ArgoCD.

• Platform Governance: Review software architecture and Kubernetes metrics to ensure high availability, capacity planning, and cost-optimization across AWS regions, and hold the team accountable to those standards.

• Incident Engineering: Lead incident response for critical events, drive complex root-cause analysis (RCA), and champion a blameless post-mortem culture across the organization.

• Collaboration & Stakeholder Management: Partner with engineering leadership to align SRE priorities with business goals, and foster adoption of new tools, security standards, and reliability best practices across teams.

You Bring

• People Leadership: Prior experience managing or leading SRE/DevOps engineers, ideally in a fintech or highly regulated environment. Able to flex between hands-on principal-level engineering and coaching and developing a team.

• Google SRE Fundamentals: Working knowledge of Google's SRE practices—SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, toil reduction, and blameless postmortems—and experience adapting them to a regulated environment.

• Linux & Networking Mastery: Proficient in Linux administration with a deep understanding of the TCP/IP stack, OSI model, DNS, and network troubleshooting.

• FinTech Background: Experience working in highly regulated financial environments or with FIX/API connectivity.

• Production Kubernetes: Hands-on experience managing production-grade clusters, including RBAC, autoscaling, Helm, and multi-cluster patterns.

• Cloud Native Expertise (AWS): Strong grasp of AWS core services, security, and high-availability patterns. Proficiency with boto3 and AWS CLI for automation.

• Modern CI/CD & GitOps: Experience building secure, automated delivery pipelines and operating GitOps workflows (ArgoCD).

• Code Proficiency: Strong scripting and development skills in Python or Golang, along with Bash and Ansible.

• Observability: Experience with Grafana/Similar tools, Prometheus, Understanding of logs shipping, management and metric first alerting.

• Security Mindset: Experience with secrets management, vulnerability scanning, and securing the software supply chain.

• AI & Prompt Engineering: Familiarity with using LLMs, Public MCPs, or Bedrock Agent Core to enhance SRE workflows.

• Data & Middleware & Orchestration: Hands-on experience with Rundeck and Airflow for job orchestration and automation, plus experience managing Kafka, MQ, or SQS.

Location

This role is open to candidates in the following locations: Chicago, IL - Hybrid

• This role is expected to come into the office on a cadence set by the Hiring Manager/Team.

• If you're not based in the location listed above, this role is not a fit, and we cannot accommodate remote work outside these locations.

• Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. DriveWealth does not sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

Pay Range: $150,000 – $170,000 USD

Working at DriveWealth

We do our best work when we're in the same room. To maintain the speed our partners expect, our New York, Chicago, and Lithuania teams work in office on a hybrid schedule. We've found that being physically side-by-side is the only way to solve complex problems in real-time and stay truly accountable to the products we ship. When you're here, you're working directly with the people making the decisions.

To support that work, we provide competitive compensation, equity, and a 401(k) match. We also offer Medical insurance, Dental insurance, Vision insurance, Disability insurance, and Paid Parental Leave, along with a wellness reimbursement, a company-provided phone, and a personal development allowance. Finally, we value the time you spend away from the office with generous Paid Time Off (PTO) and observed holidays.

Work Authorization

Applicants must possess the legal right to work in the country where the position is located at the time of application. DriveWealth requires all employees to provide original documentation verifying their work authorization on or before their first day of employment.

For US-based roles: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis without the need for current or future visa sponsorship. DriveWealth does not provide visa sponsorship or support for employment authorization, including transfers, at this time. Offers of employment are strictly contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the Company.

How We Think About AI

We leverage AI to work smarter and move faster. We seek AI-curious talent who are proactive about using emerging tools to increase signal quality, reduce friction, and improve outcomes to deliver products faster, provide better service to our partners, and to streamline processes. Your ability to leverage our internal tools and technology to drive results is as important to us as your core domain expertise.

Compensation

Pay is generally based on the level, complexity, responsibility, location, and job duties/requirements of the specific position. We then source candidates with the requisite skills, expertise, education, training, and experience.  If you are selected for an interview, please feel welcome to speak to a recruiter about our compensation philosophy and other available benefits. This role is eligible for base, bonus, equity, 401(k) match, and heavily subsidized benefits and perks.

Equal Employment Opportunity

To build technology and products that are used and loved by people and solve real-world problems, we need to build a team with many different perspectives and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Agency Disclaimer

DriveWealth does not accept agency resumes. Do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, employees, or any other organization location. DriveWealth is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

jobs.description:
Are you interested in joining an organization with a global reach? In a world of shifting threats, Concentric is your trusted ally. Powered by elite professionals from military, government, and intelligence backgrounds. If you are passionate about intelligence, risk analysis, threat management, executive protection, security operations, or business resiliency, Concentric may be the organization you’ve been searching for!

Concentric is a risk consultancy specializing in delivering strategic security and intelligence services. We provide holistic, intelligent security solutions for private clients and corporations globally. Concentric offers strategic advisory services, risk assessments, physical protection, threat intelligence, open-source monitoring, program audits, secure embedded staffing, and training for security teams and intelligence analysts.

Our ultimate goal is to be recognized as the most innovative, capable, and trusted Risk Management partner in the world, and we do this by following these core values:

Integrity – Collaboration - Relationships – Excellence – Creativity - Results

Join Us,

Concentric - "Your World Secured"

We are currently seeking to hire a Talent Acquisition Specialist  to join our Corporate team in Kirkland! This position allows for remote work arrangements from within the United States. You'll be joining a small, tight-knit team that genuinely supports one another — we work hard, move fast, and show up for each other when it counts. We trust our team deeply, giving you the flexibility and autonomy to own your work, paired with a team that always has your back.

While a Pacific Time (PT) base is preferred, we are truly open to remote candidates across all U.S. time zones. We ask that all team members maintain meaningful overlap with PST core business hours and are happy to work with the right candidate on a schedule that fits.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Concentric's Talent Acquisition team moves at startup speed, with heavy requisition loads, a high volume of interviewing, and candidates and clients who expect a high-touch, white-glove experience at every step. The Talent Acquisition Specialist owns full-cycle recruiting for a demanding portfolio of roles and is expected to keep pace without letting quality or candidate experience slip. This role works in close partnership with the Talent Acquisition Business Partner, Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist, and Global Talent Acquisition Manager, drawing on their guidance for complex searches while independently driving the day-to-day recruiting process.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Own full-cycle recruiting efforts across a high-volume requisition load from job posting and sourcing through screening, interview coordination, and offer negotiation for candidates, hiring managers, and clients.

• Deliver a consistently high-touch, white-glove candidate experience through prompt follow-up, clear communication, and attentive support from first contact through onboarding.

• Assess candidates through screens and interviews, recommend them to hiring managers, lead hiring team debriefs, and guide teams to confident final decisions.

• Partner closely with the Talent Acquisition Business Partner, Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist, and Global Talent Acquisition Manager on complex searches, executive-level roles, escalations, and process alignment.

• Leverage Greenhouse ATS and other recruiting technology, including AI-driven tools, to manage candidate records, streamline workflows, and keep hiring managers informed throughout the process.

• Build and maintain diverse, high-quality talent pipelines through proactive sourcing and outreach, LinkedIn Recruiter, referrals, community organizations, colleges, employment agencies, media, and other channels.

• Act as a brand ambassador for Concentric, representing the company externally at recruiting events, career fairs, university partnerships, and other talent engagement opportunities.

• Partner with the Global Talent Acquisition Manager and Marketing to shape branded recruiting collateral and external talent-attraction strategy.

• Support additional talent initiatives and projects as assigned.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a polished, professional presence that builds credibility quickly with senior leaders, executives, and external stakeholders

With one of the largest proprietary radiology report datasets in the world, our AI has helped uncover hundreds of new cancer diagnoses and reduced error rates in tens of millions of radiology reports by nearly 50%.

Rad AI has secured over $140M in funding, including a recently oversubscribed Series C ($68M round) led by Transformation Capital, bringing our valuation to $528M. Our investors include Khosla Ventures, World Innovation Lab, Gradient Ventures, Cone Health Ventures, and others—all backing our mission to empower physicians with cutting-edge AI.

Our latest advancements in generative AI are used by thousands of radiologists daily, supporting more than one-third of radiology groups and healthcare systems and nearly 50% of all medical imaging in the U.S. at partners including Cone Health, Jefferson Einstein Health, Geisinger, Guthrie Healthcare System, and Henry Ford Health.

Recognized as one of the most promising healthcare AI companies by CB Insights and AuntMinnie https://www.radai.com/news/auntminnie-recognizes-rad-ai-omni-reporting-as-2023s-best-new-radiology-software, and ranked by Deloitte https://www2.deloitte.com/us/en/pages/technology-media-and-telecommunications/articles/fast500-winners.html as the 19th fastest-growing company in North America, we are building AI-powered solutions that make a real impact. jobs.title: Electrical Engineer - Manufacturing Test
jobs.description:
WHAT TO EXPECT

Heron Power is a startup company building cutting-edge power electronics for the 21st-century grid. We aim to de-bottleneck the growth of electricity generation and consumption with scalable, innovative, and less costly hardware solutions, accelerating the electrification of everything.

Our first goal is to build better converters (inverters & rectifiers) to connect large-scale renewables, storage, and loads to the grid. Heron’s leadership team is made up of seasoned veterans who have designed and shipped gigawatts of power conversion products over the past decade.

We understand that no one individual knows everything. We will all learn a lot together and from each other. We strive to build a collaborative, enriching environment conducive to personal, technical, and career growth. You can expect to work in a dynamic environment, driven by first principles engineering, solving difficult problems—with a strong bias toward hands-on execution and learning by doing.

 


JOB OVERVIEW

High-reliability products are built on high-quality manufacturing and test infrastructure.

As an Electrical Engineer – Manufacturing Test, you will help develop the hardware, fixtures, and test solutions that ensure our products can be built, validated, and shipped at scale. Working closely with design engineers, manufacturing partners, and external fixture vendors, you will support the development and deployment of production test systems for PCBAs, subsystems, and integrated products.

This role sits at the intersection of electrical engineering, manufacturing, and product development. You will gain hands-on experience developing test fixtures, supporting Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and Design for Test (DFT) initiatives, troubleshooting hardware issues, and helping bring new products from prototype through production.

If you enjoy understanding how products are built, tested, and scaled into manufacturing, this role will feel like home.

 


HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE


TEST STRATEGY & DEVELOPMENT

 - Support the development of functional test coverage for PCBAs, subsystems, and production systems.

 - Review schematics, PCB layouts, and manufacturing documentation to define test requirements and validation plans.

 - Partner with design engineers to improve Design-for-Test (DFT) and Design-for-Manufacturability (DFM), including test points, diagnostics, firmware validation, and observability.

 - Help establish pass/fail criteria grounded in product performance, reliability, and manufacturing requirements.

 - Participate in engineering validation, production qualification, and end-of-line (EOL) test activities.


TEST HARDWARE & FIXTURE DEVELOPMENT

 - Design, modify, and support electrical test fixtures for PCBA validation and production testing.

 - Collaborate with external fixture vendors to develop and deploy manufacturing test solutions.

 - Support the development of bed-of-nails fixtures, interface boards, harness validation fixtures, and other production test hardware.

 - Specify, integrate, and troubleshoot instrumentation including oscilloscopes, DMMs, power supplies, electronic loads, DAQs, and communication interfaces.

 - Help deliver test stations that are reliable, maintainable, safe, and scalable.


PRODUCTION SUPPORT & DEBUG

 - Support board bring-up, hardware validation, and root-cause analysis of electrical issues.

 - Drive rapid debug loops when tests fail.

 - Improve test observability and diagnostic resolution.

 - Partner with manufacturing, quality, and engineering teams to improve yield, reduce escapes, and accelerate learning cycles.

 - Support pilot builds, NPI activities, and production ramps.


CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT

 - Generate manufacturing documentation, test procedures, and engineering change requests.

 - Support fixture maintenance, calibration, and continuous improvement efforts.

 - Help close the loop between manufacturing, design, and reliability teams.

 - Contribute to improving test coverage, manufacturing efficiency, and product quality over time.

 


WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT

 - Work across the full manufacturing test lifecycle: PCBA validation → subsystem testing → end-of-line production.

 - Gain hands-on experience with test fixtures, automated test systems, and manufacturing operations.

 - Collaborate directly with design engineers, suppliers, contract manufacturers, and fixture vendors.

 - Exposure to real-world DFM, DFT, NPI, and production scaling challenges.

 - High agency and high slope — the systems you help build directly influence product quality, manufacturing readiness, and how quickly we can ship.

 


WHAT YOU WILL BRING

We prioritize strong fundamentals, practical problem-solving, ownership, and a willingness to learn. We care as much about how you work as what you already know.

 


MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS

 - Ability to read and understand electrical schematics and PCB layouts.

 - Fundamental understanding of analog and digital circuits.

 - Familiarity with PCBAs and electronic manufacturing processes.

 - Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

 - Ability to work cross-functionally and drive issues to closure.

 


NICE-TO-HAVES

 - Experience designing or debugging simple circuits.

 - Experience with oscilloscopes, multimeters, power supplies, and other lab equipment.

 - Exposure to manufacturing test fixtures, production testing, or hardware validation.

 - Experience working with contract manufacturers, suppliers, or hardware vendors.

 - Familiarity with DFM, DFT, NPI, or PCBA manufacturing processes.

 - Experience with PCB design tools such as Altium, KiCad, Eagle, or similar.

 

If you are passionate about technology and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, we would love to hear from you. Join us in accelerating the electrification of everything at Heron Power. Heron Power provides competitive compensation (salary and equity) and benefits. The salary for this role ranges from $130,000 to $200,000 per year.

jobs.title: Commercial Finance Manager
jobs.description:
Company & Culture:
At GT’s Living Foods, we’re more than just a company – we’re a community passionate about creating a healthier, happier world. Over the last 30 years we’ve built a culture of inclusivity and authenticity, where our shared values create an environment that inspires you to do your best while achieving meaningful results. Our mission to transform health and happiness through potent, living foods has established us as the #1 Kombucha brand and a leader in the Health & Wellness space.

Requirements:

• 5–8+ years of progressive Finance/FP&A experience, preferably within CPG, food & beverage, or another consumer products environment.

• Strong experience supporting Sales, Commercial, or customer-facing organizations.

• Demonstrated understanding of Gross-to-Net, trade spending, customer profitability, pricing, and Contribution Margin.

• Experience with budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and financial modeling.

• Experience working with trade promotion management and/or customer deduction processes strongly preferred.

Job Description:

The Commercial Finance Manager serves as a key financial business partner for Sales, Revenue Growth Management (RGM), Accounting, and Commercial leadership. The role owns the financial governance and decision support required to translate commercial activity into Net Sales, Profitability, and Contribution Margin performance.

This position is responsible for ensuring the financial integrity of customer and product economics, including trade investment, accruals, deductions, customer terms, promotional ROI, and customer/SKU-level profitability.

Working closely with RGM, the Commercial Finance Manager evaluates the financial outcomes of pricing, promotional, mix, and customer strategies while maintaining clear accountability for actual performance versus plan.

Key Responsibilities:

Commercial Financial Management

• Own financial performance and analysis from Gross Sales/Net Sales through Contribution Margin across customers, channels, brands, and SKUs.

• Develop and maintain customer and SKU-level P&Ls to provide visibility into profitability and key financial drivers.

• Lead monthly analysis of Net Sales, trade investment, deductions, and Contribution Margin versus Budget, Forecast, and Prior Year.

• Identify financial risks and opportunities and translate findings into clear recommendations for Commercial leadership.

Commercial Decision Support

• Serve as the Finance partner to Sales and RGM for customer, pricing, promotional, and commercial investment decisions.

• Evaluate the financial impact of RGM recommendations, including pricing, price-pack architecture, promotional strategies, mix shifts, and customer programs.

• Develop scenario and sensitivity analyses to quantify impacts to Net Sales, Gross Margin, and Contribution Margin.

• Provide financial recommendations and guardrails to ensure commercial strategies deliver profitable growth.

Planning and Forecasting

• Support AOP, ROP, and forecast development for Net Sales, trade investment, and Contribution Margin.

• Partner with Sales and RGM to validate the financial implications of volume, price, mix, promotional, and distribution assumptions.

• Maintain forward-looking financial Risks & Opportunities related to customer and commercial performance.

• Ensure commercial forecasts reconcile to approved customer programs, trade assumptions, and financial targets.

Reporting and Executive Insights

• Develop concise, executive-ready reporting explaining commercial performance and key drivers.

• Provide customer, channel, brand, and SKU profitability insights to Commercial and Finance leadership.

• Build standardized reporting and analytical tools that improve visibility and reduce ad-hoc analysis.

• Translate complex financial information into clear business implications and recommended actions.

Qualifications & Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

• Commercial acumen: Understands how pricing, volume, mix, promotions, and customer investments translate into financial performance.

• Financial ownership: Moves beyond reporting results to identifying drivers, risks, opportunities, and recommended actions.

• Business partnership: Effectively challenges and influences Sales and Commercial partners while maintaining strong working relationships.

jobs.title: Principal Package Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Principal Package Design Engineer

Location: Hybrid at main Renesas Electronics America locations (San Jose, CA / Austin, TX)

Department: Semiconductor Power Product Group

Reports To: Senior Principal, Device Design Packaging Technology, Strategy, Operations

Position Summary

We are seeking a Principal Package Design Engineer to lead the development and integration of next-generation packaging solutions for high-performance semiconductors and electronic products. This role will focus on advanced package architecture, assembly processes, thermal and mechanical reliability, and cross-functional collaboration with design, applications, product engineering, manufacturing, suppliers, and quality teams. The ideal candidate has deep expertise in semiconductor packaging technologies and a strong track record of bringing complex products from concept through qualification and high-volume production.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead Advanced Packaging Initiatives: Lead the design, development, and qualification of advanced semiconductor packaging solutions, including:Flip-chip, Chip EmbeddingWafer-level packaging (WLP/FOWLP)Panel-level packaging (laminate, molding)2.5D/3D packagingSystem-in-package (SiP)Ball grid array (BGA/CSP)Wafer-to-wafer and die-to-wafer heterogeneous bonding
• Architecture & Simulation: Define package architecture based on electrical, thermal, mechanical, reliability, and cost requirements with hands-on, deep simulation expertise.
• OSAT & Vendor Strategy: Drive package technology and OSAT selection and development for new product introductions (NPI).
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with IC design, product definers, substrate, board, thermal, reliability, applications, and manufacturing teams to ensure package compatibility and performance.
• Layout & Stack-Up: Oversee package layout reviews, stack-up definition, material selection, and interconnect strategy.
• Simulations & Modeling: Perform and guide others on simulations and analysis related to:Signal integrity / power integrityThermal performanceMechanical stress / warpageDesign for manufacturability (DFM)
• Assembly & Qualification: Develop assembly flows and process requirements for OSATs and manufacturing partners. Lead package qualification activities, including DOE planning, failure analysis, and reliability testing.
• Yield & Issue Resolution: Resolve packaging-related issues and challenges during NPI prototype builds, qualification, and production ramp. Collaborate with suppliers and internal/external manufacturing partners on process improvements, material evaluation, and yield optimization.
• Documentation & Leadership: Create and maintain package specifications, design rules, process documentation, and technical reports. Mentor junior engineers and provide technical leadership across packaging initiatives.

Required Qualifications

• Education: MSc or PhD degree in Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or a related field.
• Experience: 5+ years of experience in advanced semiconductor packaging or advanced electronics packaging and system integration.
• Technical Depth: Strong hands-on knowledge of advanced packaging technologies, materials, assembly processes, and application system integration as they apply to AI infrastructure and data center power management.
• Reliability & Tools: Deep understanding of thermal, mechanical, and electrical interactions in package design and extensive, hands-on model setup, simulations, and analysis. Strong background in CAD and simulation tools. Experience with package reliability testing and qualification standards.
• Supply Chain: Experience working with OSATs, substrate vendors, assembly houses, and semiconductor supply chains.
• Problem Solving & Leadership: Proven ability to troubleshoot packaging failures, drive root cause/corrective action, and demonstrate strong project leadership and cross-functional communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Master’s or PhD in a relevant engineering discipline.
• Experience with power semiconductor devices and packaging including Si/SiC/GaN MOSFETs, Power Modules, Intelligent Power Modules, and their applications in consumer, industrial, automotive, and high-performance computing markets.
• Experience with power products in high-performance computing, AI/ML hardware, or mobile products.
• Hands-on experience with tools for package design and simulation such as:Cadence Allegro Package DesignerSolidWorksANSYSCOMSOLJMP / Minitab
• Knowledge of JEDEC standards, IPC standards, and semiconductor qualification methods.
• Experience in W2W, D2W, D2D 3D heterogeneous integration and chiplet-based packaging.

Key Skills

• Advanced package concept engineering and design
• Materials selection and development
• Thermal and mechanical simulations and analysis
• Failure analysis & reliability engineering
• Design for Manufacturability (DFM/DFX)
• Process development & supplier collaboration
• Technical leadership & problem-solving

Success in This Role

A successful Principal Package Design Engineer will:

• Deliver robust package solutions that meet performance, reliability, and cost targets.
• Enable smooth product transfer from concept to development to manufacturing.
• Reduce packaging risks through strong technical analysis, hands-on simulations, and qualification planning.
• Improve yield, quality, and manufacturability through collaboration with internal and external partners.

Working Conditions

• May require occasional travel to supplier, OSAT, or design/manufacturing/R&D sites.

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, To Make Our Lives Easier. With a global team of over 21,000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‑leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future.

At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives.

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Product Manager
jobs.location: Palo Alto, CA or Houston, TX
jobs.description:
About Us:

Bolo AI is building the AI company for heavy industry.

These are the sectors the world depends on: energy, utilities, manufacturing, and industrial operations. They have been underserved by modern software and AI for too long. We are changing that with AI built for their messy, high-stakes operational reality.

Customers are already using Bolo to catch critical equipment failures, recover hidden cost impact, automate operational workflows, and put decades of industrial data to work.

Backed by True Ventures, Benchstrength, Accomplice, Analog Ventures, and Beat Ventures, we are a small, AI-native team working close to the customer to make their daily work faster, safer, and better.

Role Overview:

We’re hiring a Forward Deployed Product Manager to own customer engagement outcomes from problem discovery through shipped impact.

This is not a traditional roadmap PM role, and it is not an implementation-only delivery role. You will sit at the intersection of customer, GTM, and engineering: understanding messy operational workflows, scoping the right MVP, translating customer needs into product requirements, and driving the engagement to measurable business value.

The core skill is turning ambiguity into shipped outcomes. You will work with customers who have complex workflows, fragmented data, security constraints, and high expectations. Your job is to create clarity, sequence the work, manage tradeoffs, and make sure what we build is useful for the customer and reusable for Bolo. For every customer engagement, especially pilots, the bar is not “did we deliver what we promised?” The bar is: did we create so much value that the customer does not want to live without Bolo when the pilot ends? This role is accountable for helping us reach that level of customer pull.

You will be accountable for both customer success and product learning. That means you are not just delivering one-off customer requests. You are expected to identify repeatable patterns, shape product direction, and help us build scalable delivery processes as we grow.

Note: This role can be based in Palo Alto, CA or Houston, TX. In either location, this is an in-person, customer-facing role. You should expect regular team collaboration, customer meetings, on-site discovery, and travel. Travel will vary by customer phase and may reach up to 50% during intensive discovery, deployment, or expansion periods.

What You’ll Own:

• Own customer engagements from discovery through deployment, adoption, and measurable impact.

• Build credibility with customer stakeholders across field teams, technical teams, executives, and commercial buyers.

• Immerse yourself in the customer’s world through both their data and their day-to-day workflows.

• Translate messy customer problems into clear problem statements, MVP scope, data requirements, user stories, and product requirements.

• Partner with engineering to turn customer workflows and datasets into stable, extensible AI-powered solutions.

• Manage tradeoffs across customer urgency, technical complexity, commercial value, and long-term product reuse.

• Scope phased deployments that create value quickly without creating unsustainable custom work.

• Lead customer rollout and adoption so shipped solutions become part of real workflows.

• Stay close to expansion, renewal, and commercial outcomes, not just delivery milestones.

• Identify repeatable patterns across engagements and turn them into product and delivery processes as Bolo scales.

What Success Looks Like:

• You help pilots become must-have deployments by creating clear, measurable customer value.

• You build trust with customers, engineering, GTM, and founding team by creating clarity and driving outcomes.

• You turn customer-specific learning into reusable product and delivery patterns.

Who We’re Looking For:

• 6–8+ years of experience in a high-ownership, customer-facing role such as consulting, forward-deployed product, enterprise software implementation, solutions, technical delivery, product management, or business operations.

• A track record of running complex client-facing work under ambiguity, including scoping problems, aligning stakeholders, managing tradeoffs, and driving to a concrete outcome.

• Strong commercial judgment. You understand that customer success, expansion, renewal, and product direction are connected.

• Strong technical fluency. You should be comfortable reasoning through data, integrations, AI workflows, implementation constraints, and tradeoffs with engineers.

• Clear product judgment. Direct PM experience is not required, but you should be able to define MVP scope, write clear requirements, make prioritization tradeoffs, and distinguish customer-specific requests from reusable product patterns.

• Excellent communication with executives, operators, engineers, and data teams. You can push back without becoming defensive or overly accommodating.

• Evidence that you can operate in a very early-stage startup environment: low structure, high ambiguity, fast context switching, and no perfect playbook.

• Real curiosity about AI. You actively experiment with AI tools and can think critically about where they work, where they fail, and what it takes to make them reliable in production.

• Exposure to energy, oil and gas, heavy industry, applied AI/ML, or LLM-based products is a strong plus.

What We Offer:

Bolo AI is a technology startup headquartered in Palo Alto, backed by True Ventures, Benchstrength, Accomplice, J Ventures, and Beat Ventures.  We offer competitive compensation, generous PTO, flexible working hours, an office in Palo Alto for in-person collaboration, and the following:

• Competitive Compensation: A strong base salary

• Ownership & Impact: Equity options so you can share in our success as we grow and shape the future together.

• Hybrid Work Environment: Enjoy a flexible hybrid schedule—collaborate in person and work from home.

• Growth & Opportunity: Join us at a pivotal stage where your contributions will have a direct impact on our journey. As we grow, so will your opportunities.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Applied AI
jobs.location: London, United Kingdom; New York, NY, United States; Singapore
jobs.description:
At Hudson River Trading (HRT) the Applied AI team’s mission is to increase the speed and quality of work across the firm’s most consequential workflows. We build AI systems that help researchers and developers iterate faster, automate increasingly complex work, and enable autonomous exploration at a scale that would not otherwise be possible.

We apply frontier models and agentic systems to how quantitative research, software development, and other critical work at HRT gets done. We combine cutting-edge commercial and open-source models and tools with infrastructure, research, and systems of our own.

Our work spans the full stack required to make this successful: AI infrastructure, research engineering, post-training and reinforcement learning, agent evaluation, security and alignment, and deployment into real workflows.

Responsibilities

• Building scalable infrastructure for training, evaluating, and operating language models and AI agents

• Developing research environments, evaluation systems, and experimentation platforms that allow us to measure and improve agent performance

• Improving model and agent capabilities through post-training, reinforcement learning, prompting, tool design, and workflow optimization

• Designing sandboxing, policy enforcement, monitoring, and other safeguards for increasingly capable autonomous systems

• Partnering with teams across HRT to identify work AI can newly perform, develop effective solutions, and turn successful experiments into durable systems

• Evaluating new models, techniques, and products, and making informed decisions about when to build, buy, or adapt them

• Sharing technical knowledge and establishing effective practices for building and working with AI across HRT

Profile

• You are an excellent engineer who can turn ambiguous problems into working systems

• You learn unfamiliar technical and business domains quickly and enjoy moving between them

• You care about advancing what AI systems can reliably accomplish

• You use rigorous measurement and experiment design to guide decisions

• You are comfortable operating across research and production engineering

• You communicate clearly and collaborate well with people from different technical backgrounds

• You are curious about the capabilities, limitations, and risks of increasingly autonomous systems

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience required

• Strong Python proficiency required

• Excellent software design, debugging, and problem-solving skills required

• Experience building and operating substantial software systems required

• Demonstrated engagement with modern AI systems, tools, or research required

• Machine learning research or engineering, including post-training, fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, or alignment

• AI-agent architecture, evaluation, or tool-use environments

• Distributed systems, model serving, orchestration, or high-throughput research infrastructure

• Security sandboxing, policy enforcement, adversarial testing, or governance for AI systems

• Forward-deployed engineering: working closely with users to discover, build, and operationalize new capabilities

• Linux, systems performance, networking, C++, or TypeScript

The estimated base salary range for this position is 200,000 to 300,000 USD per year (or local equivalent). The base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role will also be eligible for discretionary performance-based bonuses and a competitive benefits package.

Culture

Hudson River Trading (HRT) brings a scientific approach to trading financial products. We have built one of the world's most sophisticated computing environments for research and development. Our researchers are at the forefront of innovation in the world of algorithmic trading.

At HRT we welcome a variety of expertise: mathematics and computer science, physics and engineering, media and tech. We’re a community of self-starters who are motivated by the excitement of being at the cutting edge of automation in every part of our organization—from trading, to business operations, to recruiting and beyond. We value openness and transparency, and celebrate great ideas from HRT veterans and new hires alike. At HRT we’re friends and colleagues – whether we are sharing a meal, playing the latest board game, or writing elegant code. We embrace a culture of togetherness that extends far beyond the walls of our office.

Feel like you belong at HRT? Our goal is to find the best people and bring them together to do great work in a place where everyone is valued. HRT is proud of our diverse staff; we have offices all over the globe and benefit from our varied and unique perspectives. HRT is an equal opportunity employer; so whoever you are we’d love to get to know you.

Please be advised: Use of AI tools during interviews or assessments is strictly prohibited, unless otherwise instructed or agreed upon. We employ various methods to evaluate the authenticity of candidate responses. If we determine that AI assistance was used during any stage of the hiring process, we reserve the right to immediately disqualify your candidacy or rescind any job offers extended.

jobs.title: Sr. Staff Product Designer, Mobile Experience Strategy & Systems
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Principal Product Designer to define and advance a coherent, best-in-class mobile experience across ServiceNow.

This role will establish the strategy, principles, shared patterns, and quality standards that connect ServiceNow's Adaptive experiences with its native iOS and Android experiences. Working across Platform and business units, this leader will identify common customer needs, reconcile fragmented approaches, and help teams create mobile experiences that feel purposeful, consistent, accessible, and optimized for the strengths of each surface.

The role combines systems thinking, mobile product strategy, interaction design leadership, and hands-on design direction. It will create reference experiences and reusable patterns, guide high-priority product work, and establish the practices teams need to make strong mobile decisions independently. It will partner closely with product designers, design-system teams, Product, Engineering, Research, and business-unit leaders while remaining accountable for the coherence and quality of the end-to-end mobile experience.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with company-wide influence. Success requires deep expertise in both adaptive and native mobile design, exceptional product and interaction judgment, and the ability to align teams across a complex, federated organization without relying on formal authority.

What You'll Do:

Define the enterprise mobile experience strategy

• Establish a unified vision and multi-year strategy for mobile experiences across Adaptive and native platforms.

• Define where experiences should be adaptive, native, or intentionally shared—and provide teams with clear principles for making those choices.

• Translate company, platform, and design-system priorities into a focused mobile experience roadmap.

• Identify the highest-value opportunities for mobile to simplify work, support work in context, and extend ServiceNow beyond the desktop.

• Represent mobile experience strategy in senior design, product, engineering, and platform forums.

• Align Platform and business-unit leaders around shared priorities, investments, dependencies, and measures of success.

Create a coherent system of mobile patterns

• Identify recurring mobile workflows, interaction models, and customer needs across products and business units.

• Define reusable mobile experience patterns for navigation, search, approvals, tasks, notifications, data entry, record interaction, collaboration, offline and interrupted work, AI-assisted actions, and other common enterprise workflows.

• Establish clear relationships among shared experience patterns, Adaptive capabilities, native platform conventions, and product-specific needs.

• Ensure patterns account for different devices, form factors, input methods, orientations, operating-system behaviors, connectivity conditions, and user contexts.

• Partner with design-system designers and engineers to translate validated patterns into reusable guidance, assets, and system capabilities.

• Maintain a coherent pattern ecosystem while allowing intentional variation where customer needs or platform conventions require it.

Raise the quality of mobile product experiences

• Define what best-in-class mobile quality means for ServiceNow, including usability, interaction, visual craft, performance perception, accessibility, resilience, and platform appropriateness.

• Create reference experiences, prototypes, and exemplars that demonstrate the intended experience and quality bar.

• Provide strategic design direction and hands-on critique for high-impact mobile initiatives across Platform and the business units.

• Lead cross-product reviews to identify fragmentation, redundant solutions, system gaps, and opportunities for reuse.

• Help teams resolve complex mobile interaction problems without taking over their product ownership or delivery responsibilities.

• Ensure shared experiences are designed for real mobile contexts rather than reduced or rearranged versions of desktop workflows.

Bridge Adaptive and native experiences

• Develop a clear framework for deciding when a use case is best served through an Adaptive experience, a native experience, or a coordinated combination of both.

• Define principles for continuity across channels so users can move between desktop, Adaptive, and native experiences without losing context or confidence.

• Identify the capabilities that should remain consistent across surfaces and those that should follow native platform behaviors.

• Guide teams through tradeoffs involving reach, speed, fidelity, device capabilities, performance, accessibility, maintainability, and customer expectations.

• Surface gaps in Adaptive and native platform capabilities and translate them into prioritized system and platform needs.

• Partner with engineering and product leaders to ensure design intent is feasible, scalable, and supported by the underlying platform.

Establish mobile standards and best practices

• Define mobile experience principles, interaction standards, design guidance, and decision frameworks that teams can apply consistently.

• Incorporate iOS, Android, responsive and adaptive design conventions while maintaining a recognizable ServiceNow experience.

• Establish guidance for touch interaction, gesture use, hierarchy, density, input, feedback, motion, system permissions, device capabilities, error recovery, and edge cases.

• Embed accessibility, localization, responsive behavior, privacy, trust, and inclusive design into mobile standards from the outset.

• Clarify how mobile patterns connect to the broader design system, content standards, AI experience principles, and platform architecture.

• Keep standards current as device ecosystems, operating-system conventions, AI interaction models, and customer expectations evolve.

Enable teams across Platform and business units

• Create playbooks, decision tools, pattern guidance, workshops, demonstrations, and other resources that help teams design high-quality mobile experiences.

• Coach designers and cross-functional teams through mobile strategy, interaction, and system-design challenges.

• Build a mobile design community of practice that connects practitioners across Platform and the business units.

• Facilitate working sessions that reconcile competing needs and turn product-specific solutions into reusable patterns where appropriate.

• Help design leaders assess capability gaps and strengthen mobile craft across their teams.

• Enable distributed teams to move faster and make better mobile decisions while maintaining shared experience standards.

Use research and evidence to guide investment

• Partner with Research, Product, Analytics, and customer-facing teams to understand mobile contexts, unmet needs, adoption barriers, and workflow opportunities.

• Establish an ongoing view of mobile experience quality across the product portfolio.

• Use customer evidence, product data, competitive analysis, design audits, and team feedback to prioritize improvements.

• Define measures for mobile usability, adoption, task success, satisfaction, consistency, reuse, accessibility, and experience quality.

• Communicate insights, progress, risks, and recommendations to design and cross-functional leadership.

Scope and Partnership Model

This role provides strategic and systems leadership for mobile experience design. It works through partnership with product teams rather than replacing their ownership.

This role owns:

• The cross-company mobile experience vision, principles, and design strategy.

• The framework for choosing and coordinating Adaptive and native approaches.

• Shared mobile experience patterns, standards, and quality criteria.

• Reference experiences and prototypes that demonstrate intended behavior.

• Cross-product mobile audits, strategic reviews, and recommendations.

• Mobile design best practices, enablement, and the community of practice.

• Identification and prioritization of systemic mobile experience gaps.

Business-unit and Platform product teams own

• Product-specific mobile strategy within the shared enterprise direction.

• Customer and business outcomes for their product areas.

• End-to-end design and delivery of their mobile features and workflows.

• Product requirements, sequencing, resourcing, and roadmap commitments.

• Validation of product-specific needs with their customers and users.

Shared accountability

• Creating coherent experiences across Adaptive, native, and desktop surfaces.

• Translating recurring product needs into reusable patterns and platform capabilities.

• Ensuring high-priority mobile experiences meet the shared quality bar.

• Resolving gaps among customer needs, design intent, platform capabilities, and implementation.

• Improving reuse, adoption, and consistency without suppressing necessary product innovation.

Basic Qualifications

• 10+ years of experience in product design, mobile experience design, design systems, interaction design, or a related discipline.

• Demonstrated experience setting mobile product or experience strategy across multiple products, platforms, or business areas.

• Deep expertise designing both native iOS and Android experiences and adaptive or responsive mobile experiences.

• Exceptional interaction-design and systems-thinking skills, with a portfolio showing complex mobile workflows and reusable patterns.

• Strong understanding of Apple Human Interface Guidelines, Material Design, mobile accessibility standards, and the conventions and capabilities of modern mobile platforms.

• Experience determining when experiences should be native, adaptive, responsive, or coordinated across multiple surfaces.

• Ability to translate customer and product needs into principles, frameworks, patterns, standards, and actionable design direction.

• Demonstrated success influencing senior design, product, and engineering partners across a complex, matrixed organization.

• Experience creating prototypes and reference experiences that clarify strategy, behavior, and design intent.

• Strong understanding of enterprise workflows, platform products, shared services, and the challenges of designing for complex or regulated environments.

• Experience using research, analytics, audits, and qualitative evidence to identify systemic opportunities and measure progress.

• Excellent communication, facilitation, storytelling, and critique skills across practitioner and executive audiences.

• Demonstrated ability to mentor designers and raise craft and strategic capability without formal management authority.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience working in a federated design organization or with an enterprise design system serving multiple business units.

• Experience with workflow, productivity, enterprise SaaS, field-service, employee, or operational mobile products.

• Familiarity with offline-first experiences, push notifications, deep linking, device permissions, authentication, security, and device-specific capabilities.

• Experience designing AI-assisted or agentic mobile experiences, including patterns for trust, control, confirmation, interruption, and proactive assistance.

jobs.title: Engineering Intern — Summer 2027
jobs.description:
ABOUT FLINT

Flint is the first self-improving system for performance marketing. We connect to brands' ad accounts and optimize them through creating pages instantly for each ad group and running a learning loop that continually improves conversions. We just signed a Fortune 10 customer, and within 48 hours their customer acquisition cost decreased by 50%. We're backed by Accel, Sheryl Sandberg (former Meta COO)'s venture fund SBVP, and Neo.





WHAT YOU WILL DO DAY TO DAY

 - Own a part of the product that's live with customers and stays live after you leave.

 - Work anywhere in the stack, from the UI down to the infrastructure it runs on.

 - Use LLMs and agent workflows as everyday tools. The product is built out of them.

 - Ship to production in your first few weeks, then keep going.

 - At the end of the summer, show the whole company what you built and what it moved.


WHO YOU WORK WITH

You report to and sit with the engineers who own the part of the product you're working on.




LOCATION, DATES, AND WORK AUTHORIZATION

 - This role is onsite in our San Francisco office, five days a week, for the full 16 weeks: Monday 3 May to Friday 20 August 2027.

 - You must already be authorized to work in the United States for the whole term. We don't sponsor visas for internships, and the application asks you to confirm this.


WHAT WE LOOK FOR

 - You're in your penultimate or final year of an undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or Software Engineering.

 - You've built and shipped something we can look at: a repo, a product people use, or a hackathon project we can open and try. We weigh this heavily, and we don't ask for your GPA.

 - You're happy to pick up work anywhere in the stack.

 - When something breaks, you find out why before you change anything.


WHAT YOU GET

 - A named engineering mentor, plus a weekly one-to-one with your manager that doesn't get cancelled.

 - One project with your name on it and a before-and-after number to show for it.

 - Lunch in the office. The team is small enough that you'll know what everyone is working on.

 - A conversation about a full-time offer before you go back to school, not a form letter in October.


HIRING PROCESS

About two hours in total, and we move quickly.

 - 30 minutes with Max Levenson, our engineering lead, about your background and what you've built.

 - A 60-minute technical interview.

 - 30 minutes with Michelle Lim, our CEO and co-founder.

 - A decision within one week of the final conversation.

We’re on a mission to transform an industry that’s been stuck in the past by empowering contractors and communities through innovative technology, real-time support, and a team that truly cares.

We’re hiring a CDL Delivery Driver at our rental facility in Williston, ND, and we’re looking for someone who’s ready to grow with us, bring energy and drive to their work, and help us build the future of construction.

Schedule: Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM, and offers overtime pay after working 40 hours. (This role is subject to on-call scheduling with additional compensation provided)

Primary Responsibilities

We don’t just deliver equipment - we deliver innovation. At EquipmentShare, our technology ensures that our drivers work efficiently and effectively by providing real-time access to fleet locations, work orders, and delivery details.

• Operates vehicle according to applicable state and federal transportation laws

Because we do things differently — and we think you’ll feel it from day one. We’re a people-first company powered by cutting-edge technology. That means our proprietary T3 platform doesn’t just run our business — it also makes your job easier, safer, and more connected. Whether you’re behind the wheel, under the hood, leading a branch, or closing deals — tech supports you, and you drive us forward.

We’re a team of problem-solvers, go-getters, and builders. And we’re looking for teammates who take pride in doing meaningful work and want to be part of building something special.

You bring grit, heart, and humility to your work, and you’re excited about the opportunity to grow within a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

• Bring energy, effort, and optimism every day

A Workplace For All

At EquipmentShare, we believe the best solutions come from a team that reflects the world around us. jobs.title: Chief of Staff to the GM of Housing
jobs.description:
Flex is a growth-stage, NYC headquartered FinTech company that is creating the best rent payment experience. It’s hard to believe that it’s 2026 and paying rent on time is expensive, inflexible, and difficult. We’re here to change that! Flex enables our users to pay rent throughout the month on a schedule that better fits their finances and budget. The Strategy & Operations team serves as the “API” through which company strategy, operating rigor, and ways of working are translated into execution across Flex. As a Chief of Staff to the GM of Housing, you will operate as a trusted thought partner and execution owner for the division’s most critical initiatives.

Embedded within the Housing division, you will help define and operationalize strategic priorities, operating cadence, and success metrics. You will support the GM and functional leaders in translating high-level goals into executable plans, while personally owning large, high-impact initiatives from initial strategy through execution and delivery of measurable outcomes.

• Translate divisional goals into a clear operating system that enables strong cross-functional coordination and execution

• Own and drive end-to-end strategic initiatives for the Housing division, from problem definition and strategy development through execution and delivery of outcomes

• Communicate effectively with senior stakeholders, navigating complex problem sets with clarity and agility

• Operate at top-decile levels of speed and productivity, dealing constructively with pressure, debate, and competing priorities

• Continuously improve processes, streamline collaboration, and proactively identify opportunities to optimize how the division operates

Who You Are

• 8+ years of professional experience, ideally including time in management consulting and/or in a high-growth start-up within a Strategy, Business Operations, or Chief of Staff function

• Entrepreneurial mindset, energized by the ambiguity and pace of 0-to-1 building

• Exceptional conceptual thinker who can move fluidly from strategy to execution and make amorphous problems tractable (“fog sculpting”)

• Highly collaborative operator with strong interpersonal skills, able to drive alignment and outcomes through influence rather than authority

• Thrives in fast-paced, dynamic environments and maintains composure amid competing priorities

• Strong bias for action, paired with obsessive attention to detail and a high bar for work quality

• Excellent written and verbal communicator, skilled at distilling complexity into clear, concise narratives and executive-ready materials

• Exceptionally quantitative, combining advanced financial modeling skills with fluency in quantitative analysis, budgeting, and forecasting

Compensation

$216,000—$270,000 USD

Life at Flex

We understand that it takes a diverse team of highly intelligent, curious, determined, empathetic, and self aware people to grow a successful company. Our HQ is located in New York City, but we have employees located throughout the US, Australia, Canada and South America. We are growing quickly, but deliberately, with a focus on building an inclusive culture. jobs.title: Operations Lead
jobs.description:
IF HEALTHCARE WERE BUILT TODAY, IT WOULD LOOK COMPLETELY DIFFERENT

Personalized, preventative, and easy to navigate. A health partner that helps you understand what’s happening in your body and what to do next.

That’s what we’re building at Superpower. Our ambition is to bring together testing, clinicians, and treatments into a healthcare experience people actually want to use.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re hiring an Operations Lead to build and scale the operations behind Superpower’s member experience. Your work will focus on scaling the workforce and systems needed to support a growing member base, through projects such as improving blood draw reliability, diagnostic delivery, and vendor performance.

You’ll work closely with leadership to identify the most important problems, decide how to solve them, and own implementation. That could mean improving blood draw availability, building a staffing model for increased demand, or setting up the operations for a new service.

You’ll work with member success, clinical operations, product, engineering, and external partners. We’re looking for someone who can analyze a business problem, make a sound recommendation, and get into the details of making it work.

Success means more members receiving a reliable, high-quality experience, with service capacity, unit economics, and profitability improving as we grow. As you deliver, there is room to take on broader operational responsibility.


IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

 - Improve blood draw operations. Expand appointment availability, improve completion and reliability, and reduce errors. Investigate where the experience breaks down and work with providers and internal teams to fix the underlying causes.

 - Strengthen diagnostic and vendor operations. Improve the experience for members using specialty diagnostics, from ordering through completion. Evaluate partners, establish service standards, and manage performance and costs to improve reliability and margins.

 - Build workforce capacity and efficiency. Forecast demand, model staffing needs, and improve how work is allocated across member success and clinical operations. Build systems and use AI and automation to increase productivity while maintaining service quality.

 - Scale B2B operations. Partner with Customer Success to build repeatable processes for employer onboarding, employee activation, and ongoing service delivery. Make responsibilities and handoffs clear as the client base grows.

 - Launch new operational capabilities. Own the setup for new services and delivery models, such as new blood draw modalities, prescription operations, or expansion of services like virtual appointments, advanced diagnostics, or specialty referrals. Define the pilot, secure the vendors and staffing, build the workflows, and stay accountable for performance after launch.

 - Make operations more resilient. Turn successful improvements into repeatable processes with clear ownership, documentation, and performance measures. Strengthen the existing team’s capacity and make critical work less dependent on any one person.


YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU

 - Have 5+ years of relevant experience across operations, strategy and operations, consulting, or building a company, including at least two years in an operating role.

 - Have personally built or improved a business operation, such as a service delivery process, vendor network, or workforce model. You can explain what you owned, the decisions you made, and the results.

 - Are AI-native. You know how to use AI to investigate problems, automate workflows, and scale operations.

 - Think in systems. You look past one-off fixes to understand how incentives, handoffs, tools, data, and process interact, then redesign the system so the same problem stays solved.

 - Understand P&L impact. You can connect operational decisions to revenue, gross margin, cost-to-serve, and profit, and prioritize work based on business impact even when you do not directly own the P&L.

 - Are highly analytical and comfortable working directly with data. You can forecast demand, model capacity and costs, size opportunities, and use operational data to decide where to invest or change the approach.

 - Know how to investigate an unfamiliar process, find the underlying cause of a problem, and carry a solution through implementation and measurement.

 - Can work effectively with frontline teams, technical partners, vendors, and leadership. You communicate clearly, secure decisions, and follow through on commitments.

 - Move comfortably between setting direction and doing the detailed work yourself. You take responsibility for whether an operation works after it launches.

 - Care about improving healthcare and understand that reliability, convenience, and clear communication shape a member’s experience.


WHY JOIN SUPERPOWER

There’s a lot here to build. You’ll work on problems that directly affect how the business grows and how members experience their healthcare.

You’ll get room to make decisions, see the consequences, and take on bigger things as you deliver. If you want to build a company of your own one day, there’s plenty here to learn by doing.

If a particular project came to mind while reading this, we’d love to hear about it. Tell us what you built, what you personally owned, and what happened.


ABOUT SUPERPOWER

Superpower is a new health system on a mission to extend and enhance human life.

We started with lab testing, then data aggregation / digital twin, then an AI doctor, and now peptides.

Over the past 6 months, we have grown 10x whilst halving CAC. Now we are gearing up for hyper growth.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Manager, Creditors Rights (Remote)
jobs.description:
Location: Remote
Travel: 20% - for client visits and industry events.

We're Proof, a high-growth startup in the legal tech industry, founded in 2017. We offer a best-in-class legal services platform used by thousands of law firms and property management companies. Our platform enables law firms and collections parties to access efficient, transparent, and accessible legal and document delivery services, traditionally out of reach. We are on a path to double our business this year and are building a team to help us scale rapidly.

We welcome individuals from all backgrounds who are eager to help build a future where legal services are readily accessible, affordable, and efficient. If you have curiosity, passion, and a collaborative spirit to drive change in an outdated industry, we want you on our team.

About the Role:

We are hiring an Account Manager to own the post-contract relationship for our Creditors' Rights accounts. You take the handoff from the sales team at contract signing and own everything from there:  onboarding, ramp, retention, and growth. New logos are assigned to you throughout the year as they close.

The firms you will be managing file thousands of cases a month across multiple states, run formal audit programs, and hold their vendors to documented SLAs. You need to know their workflow, their plaintiff clients, and their operational requirements.

The right person is organized, proactive, and comfortable with operational complexity. You do not wait for clients to surface problems. You understand what good looks like for a creditors' rights firm and you hold Proof accountable to it.

What You'll Do:

Onboarding and Scoping

• Take the handoff from the AE at contract signing and lead the firm through onboarding. Define state footprint, plaintiff client mix, reporting requirements, serve attempt rules, e-filing setup, and exception handling.

• Set ramp milestones, volume targets, and reporting cadence with the firm in the first 30 days. Document and share these internally so every team member knows what was committed.

• Ensure the platform is configured to match what was sold. What the contract says and what the system does need to be the same thing.

• Identify and resolve onboarding blockers early, whether that is alt-service setup, e-filing registration, bulk upload format, or platform access, before they delay volume.

• Partner with the Solutions Architect to ensure customer success.

Retention and Account Health

• Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for your accounts. You are the person a Managing Partner or Director of Operations reaches out to when something is wrong, and you own getting it resolved.

• Maintain a regular communication cadence, monthly reviews for core accounts and formal QBRs for enterprise accounts.

• Monitor account health: serve rate, filing SLA adherence, volume trends, open job aging, complaint rate. Surface negative trends before the client does.

• Flag at-risk accounts early and escalate internally with enough specificity that the team can act on it.

Expansion and Growth

• Find and develop expansion opportunities within your existing book. New states, new plaintiff clients, new service types.

• You own the commercial conversation on expansion. You identify the opportunity, you propose and negotiate the expanded scope, and you onboard it.

• Own renewal conversations. You know the account better than anyone and you are responsible for making the case for renewal and negotiating the terms.

Platform and Industry Fluency

• Develop deep knowledge of the Proof platform. You need to know what it can do, what it cannot, how to configure it correctly, and where the edge cases are. Understand the end-to-end service of process workflow: job creation, server assignment, attempt cadence, affidavit generation, e-filing, and billing. Learn the state-specific service of process rules for your accounts' active jurisdictions. At minimum, you should know what constitutes valid service, what the filing SLA is, and what alt-service options exist.

What You'll Bring:

• Required 3 or more years of account management or client services experience in a B2B environment. Experience working with creditors’ rights law firms, law firms generally, or in the legal services space is strongly preferred. Strong organizational discipline. You manage a multi-account book without dropping things, keep your notes and CRM current, and close every open item. Clear, direct communication skills. You can write a straightforward status update to a Managing Partner and a clear internal escalation to an ops team in the same afternoon. Proactive mindset. You surface problems before they become crises. You do not wait for a client to bring you something you should have caught. Comfort with operational complexity. This is not a role where the product does everything cleanly. You will regularly manage billing exceptions, filing delays, alt-service disputes, and e-filing issues. Ability to learn new legal and regulatory frameworks quickly. You do not need to be an expert on day one, but you need to get there fast. Strongly Preferred Experience working with creditors' rights law firms or in the broader law firm space. You understand how these firms operate, who makes decisions, and what matters to them. Familiarity with service of process: service attempts, affidavit of service, e-filing, substituted service. Or a demonstrated ability to get fluent within 60 days. Prior experience with legal technology platforms, case management software, or process serving systems. Exposure to compliance-driven client relationships with audit programs, vendor questionnaires, SLA reporting requirements, and formal review cadences.

Why Proof

The Market

Creditors' rights firms are under increasing pressure to use vendors that can document clean service, hold up under audit, and file on time across multiple jurisdictions. Proof is purpose-built for that environment. The firms filing the most cases are actively looking for a better solution, and we are the platform positioned to win that business.

The Role

The creditors' rights team is small and moving fast. You will have direct visibility into every account, direct access to the leadership making product and operational decisions, and real ownership over outcomes. This is not a role where you manage a queue.

Compensation

• $130,000 base salary ($170,000 OTE)

Benefits

• Medical, dental, vision, disability insurance, and 401k available

• Work-from-home monthly stipend

• Flexible time off (paid planned and sick time, and paid holidays)

• Necessary equipment provided

E-Verify

This company participates in E-Verify, for more information view the Participation and Right to Work Posters.

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. • Self-starter capable of operating independently to drive meaningful business results.

• Willingness to roll up your sleeves and build where there isn’t yet a playbook.

• Ability to understand complex technical requirements and craft solutions that address the needs of multiple stakeholders.
